b4f215ff1b27.en: Three bugs. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 1996 the first Ariane 5 rocket destroyed itself thirty-seven seconds after launch, because reused code converted a sixty-four-bit floating-point number to a sixteen-bit integer, and it overflowed. <bookmark mark='b'/> Between 1985 and 1987 race conditions in the software of the Therac-25 radiation machine gave patients massive overdoses, and some died. <bookmark mark='c'/> In 2014 a single missing bounds check in OpenSSL let anyone read secrets out of a server's memory. <bookmark mark='d'/> All three programs had been tested. Edsger Dijkstra said it in 1970: testing can show that bugs are present, never that they are absent.
b4f215ff1b27.zh: 三个错误。<bookmark mark='a'/>1996年，第一枚阿丽亚娜5型火箭在发射37秒后自毁，原因是一段重用的代码把一个64位浮点数转换成16位整数，结果溢出了。<bookmark mark='b'/>1985年到1987年间，Therac-25 放射治疗机软件中的竞争条件让病人受到了大剂量的过量照射，其中一些人死亡。<bookmark mark='c'/>2014年，OpenSSL 里缺失的一处边界检查，让任何人都能从服务器的内存里读出秘密。<bookmark mark='d'/>这三个程序都经过了测试。艾兹格·迪杰斯特拉在1970年说过：测试可以表明错误存在，却永远不能表明错误不存在。

e923b2b5b5ca.en: Here is a bug of the famous kind. <bookmark mark='a'/> Binary search needs the midpoint to lie between low and high. The textbook line adds them and halves the sum. <bookmark mark='b'/> We turned that requirement into a logical formula over sixteen-bit integers and handed it to our own SAT solver from Part 26. In 0.03 seconds it found a counterexample: their sum overflows, wraps to a negative number, and the midpoint falls outside the range. <bookmark mark='c'/> The repaired line, which shifts the difference without a sign, makes the formula unsatisfiable: correct for every sixteen-bit input, a proof, not a test. <bookmark mark='d'/> Joshua Bloch reported in 2006 that this overflow had sat in Java's binary search for nine years. Rice's theorem says correctness cannot be decided in general, so this part goes around it three ways.
e923b2b5b5ca.zh: 这是一个著名的那类错误。<bookmark mark='a'/>二分查找需要中点落在 low 和 high 之间。教科书上的那一行把两者相加，再把和减半。<bookmark mark='b'/>我们把这个要求变成一个关于16位整数的逻辑公式，交给第26部分我们自己的 SAT 求解器。它用0.03秒找到了一个反例：两者之和溢出，绕回成一个负数，于是中点落到了范围之外。<bookmark mark='c'/>修好的那一行把差做无符号移位，它让这个公式不可满足：对每一个16位输入都正确，这是证明，而不是测试。<bookmark mark='d'/>Joshua Bloch 在2006年报告说，这个溢出在 Java 的二分查找里待了9年。莱斯定理说，正确性一般来说是不可判定的，所以这一部分从三条路绕过它。

463ad712ea4b.en: This is Part 54 of Computer Science, Built. <bookmark mark='a'/> The three ways around Rice's theorem are to write the invariants ourselves, to exhaust a finite state space, or to approximate soundly. We will prove programs with Hoare logic and weakest preconditions; reason about the heap with separation logic; model-check protocols explicitly, symbolically and with SAT; analyse programs by abstract interpretation; meet the proof assistants that check mathematics and the systems proved with them; and fuzz our own compiler until it confesses.
463ad712ea4b.zh: 这是《计算机科学，从零搭建》的第54部分。<bookmark mark='a'/>绕过莱斯定理的三条路是：自己写出不变量，穷尽一个有限的状态空间，或者做可靠的近似。我们会用霍尔逻辑和最弱前置条件证明程序；用分离逻辑对堆进行推理；以显式的方式、符号的方式以及用 SAT 对协议做模型检验；用抽象解释分析程序；认识检查数学的证明助手，以及用它们证明过的系统；还会对我们自己的编译器做模糊测试，直到它招供。

97e383a1e120.en: Chapter one. Specifications, and the first program proof.
97e383a1e120.zh: 第一章：规约，以及第一个程序证明。

3c6f020fc510.en: A program is correct only relative to a specification of what it should do. <bookmark mark='a'/> The usual form is a pair of conditions. The precondition is what the caller promises: for this maximum function, nothing at all, so it is simply true. <bookmark mark='b'/> The postcondition is what the code promises in return: the result is at least a, at least b, and equal to one of them. <bookmark mark='c'/> The specification says what; the code says how. A proof shows that they agree on every input, not only on the inputs we happened to try.
3c6f020fc510.zh: 一个程序是否正确，只是相对于一份说明它该做什么的规约而言的。<bookmark mark='a'/>通常的形式是一对条件。前置条件是调用者所承诺的：对这个求最大值的函数，什么也不要求，所以它就是“真”。<bookmark mark='b'/>后置条件是代码反过来承诺的：结果至少是 a，至少是 b，并且等于两者之一。<bookmark mark='c'/>规约说做什么；代码说怎么做。证明表明两者在每一个输入上都一致，而不只是在我们碰巧试过的那些输入上。

a14f63cdbea5.en: Writing the specification is half the work, and it is easy to get wrong. <bookmark mark='a'/> Drop the last clause of our postcondition. Returning a alone still fails. <bookmark mark='b'/> But returning thirty-two thousand seven hundred and sixty-seven, the largest sixteen-bit integer, is at least a and at least b for every input: it meets the weakened specification, and it is useless. <bookmark mark='c'/> The classic case is sorting. Ask only that the output be sorted, and returning the empty list is correct. The output must also be a permutation of the input.
a14f63cdbea5.zh: 写规约是一半的工作，而且很容易写错。<bookmark mark='a'/>去掉我们后置条件的最后一个子句。只返回 a 仍然通不过。<bookmark mark='b'/>但返回32767，也就是最大的16位整数，对每一个输入都至少是 a、至少是 b：它满足被削弱的规约，却毫无用处。<bookmark mark='c'/>经典的例子是排序。如果只要求输出是有序的，那么返回空列表就是正确的。输出还必须是输入的一个排列。

bfa7315a4812.en: Some specifications must talk about the past. <bookmark mark='a'/> To say that this code swaps x and y, the postcondition needs their starting values. We name them capital X and capital Y: ghost variables, never read or written by the program, living only in the specification. <bookmark mark='b'/> Run the three lines on sixteen-bit integers. The first adds, and the sum overflows and wraps round to a negative number. <bookmark mark='c'/> The second subtracts, and the wrap undoes itself: y now holds the old x. <bookmark mark='d'/> The third gives x the old y. In Chapter four our SAT solver proves this for every pair of values.
bfa7315a4812.zh: 有些规约必须谈到过去。<bookmark mark='a'/>要说这段代码交换了 x 和 y，后置条件需要它们的初始值。我们把它们叫作大写的 X 和大写的 Y：幽灵变量，程序从不读写它们，它们只活在规约里。<bookmark mark='b'/>在16位整数上运行这三行。第一行做加法，和溢出了，绕回成一个负数。<bookmark mark='c'/>第二行做减法，绕回又自行抵消了：y 现在存着原来的 x。<bookmark mark='d'/>第三行把原来的 y 给了 x。在第四章，我们的 SAT 求解器会对每一对值证明这一点。

dd222c5521d4.en: The idea of proving a program is as old as the stored-program computer. <bookmark mark='a'/> In June 1949, at a conference in Cambridge, Alan Turing gave a short talk called Checking a Large Routine. His example computed n factorial by repeated addition, one loop inside another, on a machine with no multiplier. Here is a routine in that spirit. <bookmark mark='b'/> Turing attached assertions to points of the flow diagram: whenever control passes here, u equals r factorial; inside the inner loop, u is s times r factorial. <bookmark mark='c'/> At the stop box the assertion is the specification itself. <bookmark mark='d'/> A run with n equal to five shows the assertion holding at every visit; the argument covers every n.
dd222c5521d4.zh: 证明程序的想法和存储程序计算机一样古老。<bookmark mark='a'/>1949年6月，在剑桥的一次会议上，阿兰·图灵做了一个简短的报告，题为《检查一个大型例程》（Checking a Large Routine）。他的例子在一台没有乘法器的机器上，用反复相加来计算 n 的阶乘，一个循环套在另一个循环里。这是一个按那种思路写的例程。<bookmark mark='b'/>图灵把断言附在流程图的各个点上：每当控制经过这里，u 等于 r 的阶乘；在内层循环里，u 是 s 乘以 r 的阶乘。<bookmark mark='c'/>在停机框处，断言就是规约本身。<bookmark mark='d'/>取 n 等于5运行一次，可以看到断言在每一次经过时都成立；而论证覆盖了每一个 n。

81c4e2de471f.en: Why assertions? Turing explained with an analogy. <bookmark mark='a'/> Checking a long addition all at once is hard. But if the writer also supplies the carries, each column can be checked on its own: four plus six plus five is fifteen, write five, carry one; and so on. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each check is small and needs no other, yet together they cover the whole sum. <bookmark mark='c'/> Assertions are a program's carries: each step between two of them is checked on its own, and the correctness of the whole follows. <bookmark mark='d'/> Turing also argued that the routine stops, by a quantity that falls at every step: Chapter three's variant.
81c4e2de471f.zh: 为什么用断言？图灵用一个类比来解释。<bookmark mark='a'/>一下子检查一个很长的加法很难。但如果写的人把进位也写出来，每一列就能单独检查：4加6加5是15，写5进1；依此类推。<bookmark mark='b'/>每一次检查都很小，也不依赖其他检查，可合在一起，它们覆盖了整个求和。<bookmark mark='c'/>断言就是程序的进位：两条断言之间的每一步都单独检查，整体的正确性随之而来。<bookmark mark='d'/>图灵还论证了这个例程会停下来，靠的是一个每一步都在减小的量：第三章的递减量。

ddbcb6abf576.en: Turing's paper was largely overlooked until Morris and Jones wrote about it in 1984. <bookmark mark='a'/> Meanwhile the idea returned. In 1967 Robert Floyd attached assertions to the edges of flowcharts, gave for each kind of box the condition that makes the step correct, and proved termination with well-founded sets. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 1969 Tony Hoare turned this into a logic of program text, with triples, axioms and rules of inference. <bookmark mark='c'/> That logic is the next chapter.
ddbcb6abf576.zh: 图灵的论文基本上被忽视了，直到1984年 Morris 和 Jones 写文章介绍它。<bookmark mark='a'/>与此同时，这个想法又回来了。1967年，罗伯特·弗洛伊德把断言附在流程图的边上，为每一种框给出使这一步正确的条件，并用良基集证明了终止。<bookmark mark='b'/>1969年，托尼·霍尔把它变成了一种关于程序文本的逻辑，有三元组、公理和推理规则。<bookmark mark='c'/>这种逻辑就是下一章的内容。

a210a79d2f92.zh: 第二章：弗洛伊德–霍尔逻辑。

73ea6f550d99.en: Hoare's logic has one kind of sentence. <bookmark mark='a'/> P, c, Q says: if P holds before c runs, and c finishes, then Q holds afterwards. <bookmark mark='b'/> Think of each assertion as a set of states: every run that starts in P and ends, ends in Q. <bookmark mark='c'/> A run that never ends satisfies the triple trivially. This is partial correctness, and termination needs its own proof. <bookmark mark='d'/> If x is five, then after x gets x plus one, x is six.
73ea6f550d99.zh: 霍尔逻辑只有一种句子。<bookmark mark='a'/>P、c、Q 是说：如果 c 运行之前 P 成立，并且 c 结束了，那么之后 Q 成立。<bookmark mark='b'/>把每个断言看作一个状态的集合：每一次从 P 出发并且结束的运行，都结束在 Q 里。<bookmark mark='c'/>一次永不结束的运行平凡地满足这个三元组。这叫部分正确性，终止需要单独证明。<bookmark mark='d'/>如果 x 是5，那么在 x 赋值为 x 加1之后，x 是6。

11fc65f076c0.en: Assignment comes first, and it runs backwards. <bookmark mark='a'/> To know what must hold before x gets e, take what we want afterwards and write e wherever it says x. <bookmark mark='b'/> We want x greater than five after x gets x plus one. Substitute: x plus one greater than five. <bookmark mark='c'/> Simplify: x greater than four. <bookmark mark='d'/> Our tool does the same to real code, here the swap's last line. <bookmark mark='e'/> Going forwards is harder: the assignment destroys the old x, and the rule needs an existential to remember it.
11fc65f076c0.zh: 赋值排在第一位，而且它是倒着走的。<bookmark mark='a'/>要知道在 x 赋值为 e 之前必须成立什么，就取我们之后想要的条件，把其中每一处 x 都写成 e。<bookmark mark='b'/>我们希望在 x 赋值为 x 加1之后，x 大于5。代入：x 加1大于5。<bookmark mark='c'/>化简：x 大于4。<bookmark mark='d'/>我们的工具对真实的代码做同样的事，这里是交换程序的最后一行。<bookmark mark='e'/>往前走更难：赋值毁掉了原来的 x，规则需要一个存在量词来记住它。

03cab4d78518.en: Sequencing glues triples together: if c one takes P to R, and c two takes R to Q, the pair takes P to Q. <bookmark mark='a'/> That gives a mechanical method. Start from the swap's postcondition at the bottom. <bookmark mark='b'/> Push it up through each line by substitution. <bookmark mark='c'/> Each assertion between two lines is the R of the rule, and no cleverness was needed. <bookmark mark='d'/> What arrives at the top must now be compared with the precondition.
03cab4d78518.zh: 顺序规则把三元组粘在一起：如果 c1 把 P 带到 R，c2 把 R 带到 Q，那么两者合起来就把 P 带到 Q。<bookmark mark='a'/>这就给出了一种机械的方法。从交换程序底部的后置条件开始。<bookmark mark='b'/>用代入把它一行一行往上推。<bookmark mark='c'/>两行之间的每一条断言就是规则里的 R，不需要任何巧思。<bookmark mark='d'/>现在必须把到达顶部的东西和前置条件作比较。

c0160a0c8935.en: The rule of consequence lets us strengthen a precondition or weaken a postcondition. <bookmark mark='a'/> This is what arrived at the top of the swap. <bookmark mark='b'/> x plus y minus y is x. <bookmark mark='c'/> And x plus y minus x is y. <bookmark mark='d'/> Reordered, it is the precondition, and the swap is proved. <bookmark mark='e'/> These identities hold in sixteen-bit wrap-around arithmetic too, so the swap is right even when the sum overflows. What remains is a statement about integers, a verification condition, for a machine to check.
c0160a0c8935.zh: 推论规则让我们可以加强前置条件，或者削弱后置条件。<bookmark mark='a'/>这就是到达交换程序顶部的东西。<bookmark mark='b'/>x 加 y 减 y 等于 x。<bookmark mark='c'/>而 x 加 y 减 x 等于 y。<bookmark mark='d'/>重新排一下顺序，它就是前置条件，交换程序证明完毕。<bookmark mark='e'/>这些恒等式在16位的回绕算术里也成立，所以即使和溢出了，交换也是对的。剩下的是一个关于整数的命题，也就是一个验证条件，留给机器去检查。

bee1deb8c70f.en: For a conditional, prove both branches, each knowing which way the test went. <bookmark mark='a'/> Push the maximum's postcondition up each branch. <bookmark mark='b'/> In one, m becomes a; in the other, b. <bookmark mark='c'/> When a is at least b, every part of the first is true; otherwise b exceeds a, and every part of the second is true. <bookmark mark='d'/> The precondition of the whole if combines the two, and it always holds, so true suffices.
bee1deb8c70f.zh: 对条件语句，要证明两个分支，每个分支都知道测试走了哪条路。<bookmark mark='a'/>把求最大值的后置条件沿每个分支往上推。<bookmark mark='b'/>在一个分支里，m 变成 a；在另一个里，变成 b。<bookmark mark='c'/>当 a 至少是 b 时，第一个的每一部分都为真；否则 b 大于 a，第二个的每一部分都为真。<bookmark mark='d'/>整个 if 的前置条件把两者合在一起，它总是成立，所以“真”就足够了。

103d65ed01cb.en: Loops need the one ingredient a machine cannot supply: an invariant. <bookmark mark='a'/> If the body, entered with the invariant and the test true, restores the invariant, then the loop leaves with the invariant and the test false. <bookmark mark='b'/> Gauss's loop adds one, two, three, up to n, and its invariant says twice s is i times i plus one. <bookmark mark='c'/> After the body, twice the new s is twice s plus twice i plus one. <bookmark mark='d'/> The invariant replaces twice s; factor out i plus one, and it is the invariant again, one step on. <bookmark mark='e'/> At the exit, i equals n: Gauss's formula.
103d65ed01cb.zh: 循环需要一样机器提供不了的东西：不变量。<bookmark mark='a'/>如果循环体在不变量和测试都为真时进入，又恢复了不变量，那么循环退出时，不变量为真而测试为假。<bookmark mark='b'/>高斯的循环把1、2、3一直加到 n，它的不变量说：2倍的 s 等于 i 乘以 i 加1。<bookmark mark='c'/>循环体执行之后，2倍的新 s 等于2倍的 s 加上2倍的 i 加1。<bookmark mark='d'/>用不变量替换2倍的 s；提出公因式 i 加1，它又是不变量，只是往前走了一步。<bookmark mark='e'/>在出口处，i 等于 n：这就是高斯公式。

a573a2966f90.en: Two questions about any logic. <bookmark mark='a'/> Is it sound: is every derived triple true? Yes, by induction on the derivation. <bookmark mark='b'/> Is it complete: can every true triple be derived? Not absolutely. The triple true, c, false holds exactly when c never halts, which is undecidable, and assertions about integers contain all of arithmetic, which Gödel showed no proof system captures. <bookmark mark='c'/> Stephen Cook proved in 1978 the best possible result: if the consequence rule may consult every true assertion, and assertions can express what proofs need, every true triple is derivable. Hoare logic is complete relative to arithmetic.
a573a2966f90.zh: 关于任何一种逻辑，都有两个问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>它可靠吗：每个推导出来的三元组都为真吗？是的，对推导做归纳即可。<bookmark mark='b'/>它完备吗：每个为真的三元组都能推导出来吗？不是绝对的。三元组“真、c、假”成立，恰好当 c 永不停机，而这是不可判定的；而且关于整数的断言包含了全部算术，哥德尔证明了没有哪个证明系统能把它完全刻画。<bookmark mark='c'/>1978年，斯蒂芬·库克证明了可能的最好结果：如果推论规则可以查阅每一条为真的断言，并且断言能表达证明所需要的东西，那么每一个为真的三元组都可以推导出来。霍尔逻辑相对于算术是完备的。

46f1fe6364a0.en: Binary search is the classic test of reasoning about a loop. <bookmark mark='a'/> We look in a sorted array for the first element at least x. Two indices, low and high, bracket the answer. <bookmark mark='b'/> The invariant: everything left of low is less than x, everything from high on is at least x, and low never passes high. <bookmark mark='c'/> Each step looks at the middle and moves one end, keeping the invariant true. <bookmark mark='d'/> When low meets high nothing unknown is left, and the invariant alone says that low is the answer.
46f1fe6364a0.zh: 二分查找是对循环推理的经典考验。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们在一个有序数组里找第一个至少为 x 的元素。两个下标 low 和 high 把答案夹在中间。<bookmark mark='b'/>不变量是：low 左边的一切都小于 x，从 high 开始的一切都至少是 x，而且 low 永远不会越过 high。<bookmark mark='c'/>每一步看中间的元素，移动一端，并保持不变量为真。<bookmark mark='d'/>当 low 和 high 相遇时，再没有未知的部分，单凭不变量就能说明 low 就是答案。

c0d039df620f.en: Our checker sees the loop's skeleton. <bookmark mark='a'/> The comparison with the array becomes an unknown c, chosen afresh on every pass, so whatever is proved holds for every array and every target. <bookmark mark='b'/> The assertion inside is the array access: the middle index must be in range. <bookmark mark='c'/> We supply the invariant, low between zero and high, and a variant, high minus low. <bookmark mark='d'/> Out come five verification conditions. Bit-blasted over sixteen-bit integers and given to our SAT solver from Part 26, all five are valid; the hardest took about one and a half seconds. The search property itself needs reasoning about arrays, which this small checker leaves out.
c0d039df620f.zh: 我们的检查器看到的是循环的骨架。<bookmark mark='a'/>与数组的比较变成一个未知量 c，每一轮重新选取，所以证明出来的东西对每一个数组、每一个目标都成立。<bookmark mark='b'/>里面的断言就是数组访问：中间的下标必须在范围之内。<bookmark mark='c'/>我们提供不变量，low 在零和 high 之间，以及一个递减量，high 减 low。<bookmark mark='d'/>产出五个验证条件。在16位整数上做位展开，交给第26部分的 SAT 求解器，五个全部有效；最难的一个花了大约1.5秒。查找性质本身需要对数组进行推理，这个小检查器把它略去了。

1e4572b4c781.en: Now restore the textbook midpoint: add low and high, and halve. <bookmark mark='a'/> The solver no longer proves the invariant preserved. It returns a counterexample: low fifteen thousand and seventy-two, high twenty-five thousand five hundred and fifty-eight. <bookmark mark='b'/> Their sum, forty thousand six hundred and thirty, is beyond the largest sixteen-bit integer, and wraps round to minus twenty-four thousand nine hundred and six. <bookmark mark='c'/> Halved, that is minus twelve thousand four hundred and fifty-three, far below low: the array access fails. <bookmark mark='d'/> Joshua Bloch reported in 2006 that this line was in Java's library, and in the binary search Jon Bentley had proved correct in Programming Pearls. That proof was right about mathematical integers, and wrong about the machine.
1e4572b4c781.zh: 现在恢复教科书上的中点：把 low 和 high 相加，再减半。<bookmark mark='a'/>求解器不再能证明不变量得到保持。它返回一个反例：low 是15072，high 是25558。<bookmark mark='b'/>它们的和40630，超过了最大的16位整数，绕回成负24906。<bookmark mark='c'/>减半之后是负12453，远远低于 low：数组访问失败了。<bookmark mark='d'/>Joshua Bloch 在2006年报告说，这一行就在 Java 的库里，也在乔恩·本特利在《编程珠玑》中证明为正确的那个二分查找里。那个证明对数学上的整数是对的，对机器却是错的。

64713d941ed1.en: The solver can judge every proposed repair. <bookmark mark='a'/> The textbook midpoint fails. Bloch's first fix, low plus half the difference, is proved for non-negative indices; his second, an unsigned shift of the sum, is proved too, because the shift reads the lost carry back as the top bit. <bookmark mark='b'/> Drop the assumption that low is non-negative, and the first fix fails as well: the difference itself overflows. <bookmark mark='c'/> Shifting the difference without a sign is right for every low below high. Each verdict took a fraction of a second.
64713d941ed1.zh: 求解器可以评判每一个被提出的修补。<bookmark mark='a'/>教科书上的中点失败了。Bloch 的第一个修正，low 加上差的一半，对非负下标得到了证明；他的第二个修正，对和做无符号移位，也得到了证明，因为这个移位把丢掉的进位当作最高位读了回来。<bookmark mark='b'/>去掉 low 非负这个假设，第一个修正也失败了：差本身就溢出了。<bookmark mark='c'/>把差做无符号移位，对每一个小于 high 的 low 都是对的。每一个判定都只花了不到一秒。

3d88bebef6c3.en: Partial correctness says nothing if the loop runs for ever; total correctness adds termination, and the tool is a variant. <bookmark mark='a'/> Find a quantity that stays non-negative and that every pass makes strictly smaller. Here it is high minus low. <bookmark mark='b'/> Moving low to mid plus one shrinks the gap, because mid is at least low; moving high to mid shrinks it, because mid is below high. <bookmark mark='c'/> Both lean on the midpoint lying in range, and with the textbook midpoint the solver refutes this condition too. <bookmark mark='d'/> In a run the gap falls at every pass, and a natural number cannot fall for ever.
3d88bebef6c3.zh: 如果循环永远运行下去，部分正确性什么也说明不了；完全正确性加上了终止，而工具就是递减量。<bookmark mark='a'/>找一个始终非负、并且每一轮都严格变小的量。这里它是 high 减 low。<bookmark mark='b'/>把 low 移到 mid 加1会缩小间隔，因为 mid 至少是 low；把 high 移到 mid 也会缩小它，因为 mid 小于 high。<bookmark mark='c'/>两者都依赖于中点落在范围之内，而用教科书上的中点，求解器把这个条件也驳倒了。<bookmark mark='d'/>在一次运行中，间隔每一轮都在缩小，而一个自然数不可能永远缩小下去。

e79f8c4087e2.en: Variants need not be numbers. <bookmark mark='a'/> A termination proof needs only an order with no infinite descending chain: a well-founded order. <bookmark mark='b'/> Pairs compared like words in a dictionary are one. The second number may jump up whenever the first goes down, so a descent can be long, but never endless. <bookmark mark='c'/> That is how one proves that Ackermann's function terminates, though its values explode: every recursive call makes its pair of arguments smaller in this order. <bookmark mark='d'/> Floyd proved termination with such sets in 1967.
e79f8c4087e2.zh: 递减量不一定是数。<bookmark mark='a'/>终止证明只需要一种没有无限下降链的序：良基序。<bookmark mark='b'/>像字典里的词那样比较的数对就是一种。只要第一个数减小，第二个数就可以往上跳，所以一次下降可以很长，但永远不会没有尽头。<bookmark mark='c'/>人们正是这样证明阿克曼函数会终止的，尽管它的值会爆炸式增长：每一次递归调用都让它的参数对在这种序下变小。<bookmark mark='d'/>弗洛伊德在1967年用这样的集合证明了终止。

5dbb3ee9f70a.en: Chapter four. Weakest preconditions, checked by SAT.
5dbb3ee9f70a.zh: 第四章：最弱前置条件，用 SAT 检查。

03be5d19046f.en: Hoare's rules check a proof; Dijkstra's weakest preconditions compute one. <bookmark mark='a'/> For a statement c and a postcondition Q, the weakest precondition is the set of all starting states from which c is sure to finish inside Q. <bookmark mark='b'/> Every valid precondition lies inside it, so a triple holds exactly when its precondition implies the weakest one. <bookmark mark='c'/> Dijkstra introduced the idea in 1975, with his guarded commands, as a calculus for deriving programs together with their proofs. Read as a function from postconditions to preconditions, it turns proving into calculating.
03be5d19046f.zh: 霍尔的规则检查一个证明；迪杰斯特拉的最弱前置条件则计算出一个证明。<bookmark mark='a'/>对一条语句 c 和一个后置条件 Q，最弱前置条件是所有这样的初始状态的集合：从它们出发，c 一定会结束在 Q 里面。<bookmark mark='b'/>每一个有效的前置条件都位于它之内，所以一个三元组成立，恰好当它的前置条件蕴涵最弱前置条件。<bookmark mark='c'/>迪杰斯特拉在1975年和他的守卫命令一起提出了这个想法，作为一种把程序和它们的证明一起推导出来的演算。把它读作一个从后置条件到前置条件的函数，它就把证明变成了计算。

af955334bec4.en: The rules become equations. <bookmark mark='a'/> Assignment is substitution. A sequence takes the second statement first, then the first. A conditional splits on its test. An assertion adds a conjunct, and havoc, an unknown value, means the condition must hold for every value. <bookmark mark='b'/> Here is our tool on the start of Gauss's loop. The loop contributes its invariant. <bookmark mark='c'/> Pushing it up through s gets zero writes zero for s; through i gets zero, zero for i. <bookmark mark='d'/> What remains must follow from the precondition, n at least zero. That implication is the first verification condition, and it is plainly true.
af955334bec4.zh: 规则变成了等式。<bookmark mark='a'/>赋值是代入。顺序组合先处理第二条语句，再处理第一条。条件语句按它的测试分开。断言添上一个合取项，而 havoc，也就是一个未知的值，意味着条件必须对每一个值都成立。<bookmark mark='b'/>这是我们的工具处理高斯循环的开头。循环贡献出它的不变量。<bookmark mark='c'/>把它往上推过 s 赋值为零，就是把 s 写成零；推过 i 赋值为零，就是把 i 写成零。<bookmark mark='d'/>剩下的必须由前置条件，n 至少为零，推出来。这个蕴涵就是第一个验证条件，它显然为真。

5c58c0afa790.en: Loops are where the calculation needs help. <bookmark mark='a'/> We give the generator the loop's invariant and a variant. <bookmark mark='b'/> It turns the program into five closed formulas: the invariant is established on entry, preserved by the body, and together with the exit test gives the postcondition; the variant stays non-negative, and falls on every pass. <bookmark mark='c'/> Each formula speaks only about integers. The program has disappeared. If all of them are valid, the program is correct; if one fails, either the program or its annotation is wrong.
5c58c0afa790.zh: 循环正是计算需要帮助的地方。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们把循环的不变量和一个递减量交给生成器。<bookmark mark='b'/>它把程序变成五个封闭公式：不变量在进入时成立，被循环体保持，并且和退出测试一起推出后置条件；递减量保持非负，并且每一轮都减小。<bookmark mark='c'/>每个公式只谈论整数。程序已经消失了。如果它们全部有效，程序就是正确的；如果有一个不成立，那么要么程序错了，要么它的标注错了。

b752a94bf773.en: How does a SAT solver judge a statement about integers? <bookmark mark='a'/> A formula is valid exactly when its negation has no satisfying assignment. So we negate it, and translate. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each sixteen-bit integer becomes sixteen Boolean variables, and addition becomes a chain of full adders passing carries along, the circuit of Part 4. <bookmark mark='c'/> Every gate becomes a new variable and a few clauses; for an and gate, three. <bookmark mark='d'/> For the swap, the result is four hundred and twenty-five variables and one thousand two hundred and thirty-nine clauses. Our CDCL solver from Part 26 shows them unsatisfiable in about a quarter of a second, so the swap is right for every pair of sixteen-bit values.
b752a94bf773.zh: SAT 求解器怎样评判一个关于整数的命题？<bookmark mark='a'/>一个公式有效，恰好当它的否定没有满足赋值。所以我们把它取否定，再翻译。<bookmark mark='b'/>每个16位整数变成16个布尔变量，加法变成一串传递进位的全加器，也就是第4部分的电路。<bookmark mark='c'/>每个门变成一个新变量和几个子句；一个与门是三个。<bookmark mark='d'/>对交换程序，结果是425个变量和1239个子句。第26部分的 CDCL 求解器在大约四分之一秒内表明它们不可满足，所以对每一对16位的值，交换都是对的。

329d00877fa8.en: Here is every program of this part so far. <bookmark mark='a'/> The maximum, the swap and the binary search loop are proved at sixteen bits. Gauss's loop is proved at eight bits, for a reason we are about to see. <bookmark mark='b'/> The binary search with the textbook midpoint is refuted: two of its five conditions fail, each with concrete values from the solver. <bookmark mark='c'/> A counterexample is never taken on trust. The tool evaluates the formula on the solver's values and checks that it really is false.
329d00877fa8.zh: 这是这一部分到目前为止的每一个程序。<bookmark mark='a'/>求最大值、交换和二分查找的循环在16位上得到证明。高斯的循环在8位上得到证明，原因我们马上就会看到。<bookmark mark='b'/>用教科书中点的二分查找被驳倒了：它的五个条件中有两个不成立，每个都带着求解器给出的具体值。<bookmark mark='c'/>反例从来不会被盲目相信。工具会在求解器给出的值上对公式求值，检查它确实为假。

ea772bf20b80.en: Multiplication is where this approach strains. <bookmark mark='a'/> Gauss's conditions compare two products, and multipliers are the classic hard case for SAT. Every two extra bits of word cost our solver several times as long: from five milliseconds at four bits to over two seconds at ten. <bookmark mark='b'/> Industrial verifiers hand their conditions to SMT solvers such as Z3, from Microsoft Research, which pair a SAT search with decision procedures for arithmetic, arrays and bit-vectors. Dafny, for one, works this way. <bookmark mark='c'/> And when a solver says unsatisfiable, it can also emit a proof that a small independent checker verifies, a theme that Chapter ten makes central.
ea772bf20b80.zh: 乘法是这种方法吃力的地方。<bookmark mark='a'/>高斯的条件比较两个乘积，而乘法器是 SAT 的经典难题。字长每多两位，我们的求解器就要多花好几倍的时间：从4位时的5毫秒，到10位时的2秒多。<bookmark mark='b'/>工业级的验证器把它们的条件交给 SMT 求解器，比如微软研究院的 Z3，它把 SAT 搜索与针对算术、数组和位向量的判定过程结合起来。比如 Dafny 就是这样工作的。<bookmark mark='c'/>而当求解器说不可满足时，它还能给出一个证明，由一个小而独立的检查器来验证，这是第十章会放到中心的主题。

7e05d8821ce0.en: Hoare's logic treats each variable as its own box, and pointers break that. <bookmark mark='a'/> Suppose y's field holds two, and we store three through x. The assignment axiom says y's field still holds two, since the postcondition never mentions x. <bookmark mark='b'/> If x and y point to different cells, that is right. <bookmark mark='c'/> If they point to the same cell, it is false. <bookmark mark='d'/> The classical repair treats the heap as one big array, and every read must then ask whether two pointers are equal. <bookmark mark='e'/> With n pointers, that is about n squared over two cases.
7e05d8821ce0.zh: 霍尔逻辑把每个变量当作一个独立的盒子，而指针打破了这一点。<bookmark mark='a'/>假设 y 的字段存着2，我们通过 x 存入3。赋值公理说 y 的字段仍然存着2，因为后置条件从没提到 x。<bookmark mark='b'/>如果 x 和 y 指向不同的单元，这是对的。<bookmark mark='c'/>如果它们指向同一个单元，这就是错的。<bookmark mark='d'/>经典的补救办法是把堆当作一个大数组，于是每一次读取都必须问两个指针是否相等。<bookmark mark='e'/>有 n 个指针时，大约是 n 的平方除以2种情形。

5569a60e8390.en: Around two thousand and one, John Reynolds, Peter O'Hearn and Hongseok Yang made each assertion describe a piece of the heap. <bookmark mark='a'/> Emp holds of the empty heap; x points to v holds of exactly one cell. <bookmark mark='b'/> The separating conjunction, P star Q, says the heap splits into two disjoint parts, P holding of one and Q of the other. <bookmark mark='c'/> Two cells joined by the star are at different addresses; joined by an ordinary and, they must be the same cell. <bookmark mark='d'/> A list is either empty, or a first node separately joined to the rest of the list.
5569a60e8390.zh: 2001年前后，约翰·雷诺兹、Peter O'Hearn 和 Hongseok Yang 让每个断言描述堆的一部分。<bookmark mark='a'/>emp 对空堆成立；x 指向 v 恰好对一个单元成立。<bookmark mark='b'/>分离合取，P 星 Q，说的是堆分成两个不相交的部分，P 对其中一部分成立，Q 对另一部分成立。<bookmark mark='c'/>用星号连起来的两个单元位于不同的地址；用普通的“与”连起来，它们就必须是同一个单元。<bookmark mark='d'/>一个列表要么是空的，要么是第一个结点，再分离地连着列表的其余部分。

dcc6411ffa72.en: The heap's rules are small. <bookmark mark='a'/> A store into the cell at x needs exactly that cell; reading, allocating and freeing are just as local. <bookmark mark='b'/> Everything else comes back through the frame rule: if c takes P to Q, it takes P star R to Q star R, provided c changes none of R's variables. <bookmark mark='c'/> What c touches is its footprint; the rest is the frame. <bookmark mark='d'/> Our store: the small axiom gives x points to three. <bookmark mark='e'/> Frame on y points to two. The star already excludes aliasing, so there is no case split. O'Hearn calls this local reasoning.
dcc6411ffa72.zh: 堆的规则都很小。<bookmark mark='a'/>向 x 处的单元存值，恰好需要那一个单元；读取、分配和释放也同样是局部的。<bookmark mark='b'/>其他一切都通过框架规则回来：如果 c 把 P 带到 Q，那么它把 P 星 R 带到 Q 星 R，前提是 c 不改变 R 的任何变量。<bookmark mark='c'/>c 触及的部分是它的足迹；其余的是框架。<bookmark mark='d'/>我们的存值：小公理给出 x 指向3。<bookmark mark='e'/>再框上 y 指向2。星号已经排除了别名，所以不需要分情形讨论。O'Hearn 把这叫作局部推理。

9c6e06cfda0c.en: Reynolds' showcase was reversing a linked list in place. <bookmark mark='a'/> The variable i walks down the old list, j collects the reversed part, and k remembers the way on. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each pass saves i's successor, turns i's next pointer round to j, and moves both one node on. <bookmark mark='c'/> One node at a time leaves i's list for the front of j's, until i is nil. <bookmark mark='d'/> Nothing is allocated or freed. Correctness means the two lists never share a cell and never lose one, which is exactly what the star can say.
9c6e06cfda0c.zh: 雷诺兹的招牌例子是原地反转一个链表。<bookmark mark='a'/>变量 i 沿着旧列表往下走，j 收集已经反转的部分，k 记住接下来的路。<bookmark mark='b'/>每一轮保存 i 的后继，把 i 的 next 指针掉头指向 j，再把两者都往前移一个结点。<bookmark mark='c'/>每次一个结点离开 i 的列表，来到 j 的列表的前端，直到 i 为 nil。<bookmark mark='d'/>没有分配，也没有释放任何东西。正确性意味着两个列表从不共享一个单元，也从不丢掉一个单元，而这正是星号能表达的。

0ccb1edc6b9e.en: One invariant does it. <bookmark mark='a'/> Two lists, alpha from i and beta from j, kept apart by the star; and the original list reversed equals alpha reversed followed by beta. <bookmark mark='b'/> Enter the body with i not nil: i's list has a first node, a. <bookmark mark='c'/> Unfold it; reading i dot next names the rest k. <bookmark mark='d'/> The store into i dot next touches one cell. The small axiom handles it, and the frame rule carries both other lists through. <bookmark mark='e'/> Fold: i now heads the list a followed by beta. <bookmark mark='f'/> Renaming restores the invariant. <bookmark mark='g'/> At the exit alpha is empty, and j holds the list reversed.
0ccb1edc6b9e.zh: 一个不变量就够了。<bookmark mark='a'/>两个列表，从 i 出发的 alpha 和从 j 出发的 beta，用星号分开；并且原列表的反转等于 alpha 的反转后面接上 beta。<bookmark mark='b'/>在 i 不为 nil 时进入循环体：i 的列表有第一个结点 a。<bookmark mark='c'/>把它展开；读取 i.next 把其余部分命名为 k。<bookmark mark='d'/>对 i.next 的存值只触及一个单元。小公理处理它，框架规则把另外两个列表原样带过去。<bookmark mark='e'/>折叠：i 现在是列表 a 后接 beta 的表头。<bookmark mark='f'/>重新命名就恢复了不变量。<bookmark mark='g'/>在出口处 alpha 为空，而 j 存着反转后的列表。

09697170e5f2.en: The frame rule also makes proofs compositional. <bookmark mark='a'/> A procedure's specification mentions only its footprint, so it is proved once, alone, and reused anywhere. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 2009 Calcagno, Distefano, O'Hearn and Yang inferred such specifications by bi-abduction: at each call, find the heap the caller is missing, and the frame the call leaves alone. <bookmark mark='c'/> Facebook bought Monoidics, the start-up behind it, in 2013. Its analyser, Infer, open source since 2015, checks code changes for null dereferences and leaks. <bookmark mark='d'/> Concurrent separation logic won O'Hearn and Stephen Brookes the 2016 Gödel Prize, and its descendant, Iris, underlies the RustBelt proofs about Rust that Part 55 returns to.
09697170e5f2.zh: 框架规则还让证明变得可组合。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个过程的规约只提到它的足迹，所以它只需单独证明一次，就能在任何地方重用。<bookmark mark='b'/>2009年，Calcagno、Distefano、O'Hearn 和 Yang 用双向溯因推断出这样的规约：在每一次调用处，找出调用者缺少的那部分堆，以及调用不去碰的框架。<bookmark mark='c'/>Facebook 在2013年收购了它背后的初创公司 Monoidics。它的分析器 Infer 从2015年起开源，检查代码变更中的空指针解引用和泄漏。<bookmark mark='d'/>并发分离逻辑为 O'Hearn 和 Stephen Brookes 赢得了2016年的哥德尔奖，而它的后代 Iris 是 RustBelt 关于 Rust 的那些证明的基础，第55部分会再谈到它们。

5634f7b2d1b3.en: A model checker explores behaviour rather than text. <bookmark mark='a'/> Behaviour is a Kripke structure, after Saul Kripke's semantics for modal logic: a set of states, some of them initial. <bookmark mark='b'/> Transitions say which state can follow which; every state has a successor, so every run is an infinite path. <bookmark mark='c'/> Each state is labelled with the simple facts true in it. <bookmark mark='d'/> Peterson's lock from Part 33, explored breadth first by our checker, has twenty states and forty-six transitions.
5634f7b2d1b3.zh: 模型检验器探索的是行为，而不是文本。<bookmark mark='a'/>行为是一个克里普克结构，得名于索尔·克里普克为模态逻辑给出的语义：一个状态集合，其中一些是初始状态。<bookmark mark='b'/>转移说明哪个状态可以跟在哪个状态后面；每个状态都有后继，所以每一次运行都是一条无限路径。<bookmark mark='c'/>每个状态都标上在其中为真的简单事实。<bookmark mark='d'/>第33部分的彼得森锁，由我们的检验器按广度优先探索，有20个状态和46条转移。

0327ad065c6b.en: Unroll the structure from its initial state, and you get a tree of every possible future. <bookmark mark='a'/> Amir Pnueli's linear temporal logic, of 1977, speaks of one path at a time: always, eventually, until. <bookmark mark='b'/> Clarke and Emerson's CTL, of 1981, adds path quantifiers: A for all paths, E for some. <bookmark mark='c'/> E F q: some path reaches q. True. <bookmark mark='d'/> A G p: p everywhere, on every path. False. <bookmark mark='e'/> A F q: every path reaches q. False: this one stays in the dead end. <bookmark mark='f'/> E G p: some path keeps p for ever. True, round the loop.
0327ad065c6b.zh: 把这个结构从它的初始状态展开，就得到一棵包含每一种可能未来的树。<bookmark mark='a'/>Amir Pnueli 1977年的线性时序逻辑，一次只谈论一条路径：总是、最终、直到。<bookmark mark='b'/>克拉克和埃默森1981年的 CTL 加上了路径量词：A 表示所有路径，E 表示某条路径。<bookmark mark='c'/>E F q：某条路径到达 q。为真。<bookmark mark='d'/>A G p：在每条路径上，处处都是 p。为假。<bookmark mark='e'/>A F q：每条路径都到达 q。为假：这一条停在了死胡同里。<bookmark mark='f'/>E G p：某条路径永远保持 p。为真，绕着那个环走。

679e149bbc86.en: CTL is checked backwards, over sets of states. <bookmark mark='a'/> E F q holds now, or one step later. <bookmark mark='b'/> That is an equation in an unknown set, and E F q is its least solution. <bookmark mark='c'/> Iterate: start with the q states, add every state with a successor in the set, and repeat. The set grows backwards along the transitions. <bookmark mark='d'/> After four rounds nothing changes, and the dead end never joins. <bookmark mark='e'/> E G is a greatest fixpoint, the rest follow by duality, and the whole check takes time linear in the structure, as Clarke, Emerson and Sistla showed in 1986.
679e149bbc86.zh: CTL 是倒着检查的，在状态集合上进行。<bookmark mark='a'/>E F q 要么现在成立，要么晚一步成立。<bookmark mark='b'/>这是一个关于未知集合的方程，而 E F q 是它的最小解。<bookmark mark='c'/>迭代：从 q 状态开始，把每一个在集合里有后继的状态加进来，然后重复。集合沿着转移倒着增长。<bookmark mark='d'/>四轮之后再没有变化，死胡同始终没有加入。<bookmark mark='e'/>E G 是一个最大不动点，其余的由对偶性得出，整个检查所花的时间与结构的大小成线性，这是克拉克、埃默森和 Sistla 在1986年证明的。

039f92ecddf8.en: Now a real algorithm. <bookmark mark='a'/> Peterson's lock: raise your flag, give the other process the turn, and wait until its flag is down or the turn is yours. <bookmark mark='b'/> Our checker answers six questions over all twenty states. Mutual exclusion holds; the lock never gets stuck; a waiting process can always get in. <bookmark mark='c'/> But a waiting process does not always get in. <bookmark mark='d'/> Part 33's checker, working with single loads and stores, agrees on mutual exclusion.
039f92ecddf8.zh: 现在来看一个真正的算法。<bookmark mark='a'/>彼得森锁：举起你的旗子，把轮次让给另一个进程，然后等待，直到它的旗子放下，或者轮到你。<bookmark mark='b'/>我们的检验器在全部20个状态上回答六个问题。互斥成立；锁永远不会卡住；一个等待的进程总是能够进去。<bookmark mark='c'/>但一个等待的进程并不总是会进去。<bookmark mark='d'/>第33部分的检验器以单次的读取和存储为单位工作，在互斥这一点上与它一致。

3b6bf55a2767.en: That failure is about liveness: something good must eventually happen. <bookmark mark='a'/> Whenever process zero tries, it eventually gets in. <bookmark mark='b'/> The counterexample is a lasso, a stem followed by a cycle repeated for ever. Process zero raises its flag and gives away the turn. <bookmark mark='c'/> The door is open, but the scheduler only ever runs process one, which idles. <bookmark mark='d'/> No real scheduler is that unfair. Assume weak fairness, that a step which stays enabled is eventually taken, and the property holds for both processes.
3b6bf55a2767.zh: 那个失败关乎活性：某件好事最终必须发生。<bookmark mark='a'/>每当进程零尝试进入，它最终都会进去。<bookmark mark='b'/>反例是一个套索，一段柄后面跟着一个永远重复的环。进程零举起旗子，让出轮次。<bookmark mark='c'/>门是开着的，但调度器只运行进程一，而进程一什么也不做。<bookmark mark='d'/>没有哪个真实的调度器会那么不公平。假定弱公平性，也就是一个一直保持可执行的步骤最终会被执行，那么这个性质对两个进程都成立。

a33f9600d75c.en: A failed check comes with a counterexample. <bookmark mark='a'/> Give away the turn before raising the flag, and the checker finds a six-step path to both processes in the critical section. <bookmark mark='b'/> The search is breadth first, so no shorter path exists. <bookmark mark='c'/> The same tool checks a small Raft election from Part 38: with three nodes and two terms, never two leaders in one term. <bookmark mark='d'/> Plant a voter that forgets its vote, and two leaders appear in the same term after six steps.
a33f9600d75c.zh: 失败的检查会附带一个反例。<bookmark mark='a'/>先让出轮次再举起旗子，检验器就找到一条六步的路径，让两个进程同时进入临界区。<bookmark mark='b'/>搜索是广度优先的，所以不存在更短的路径。<bookmark mark='c'/>同一个工具还检查了第38部分的一个小型 Raft 选举：三个结点、两个任期，一个任期里永远不会有两位领导者。<bookmark mark='d'/>植入一个会忘记自己投票的投票者，六步之后，同一个任期里就出现了两位领导者。

4c38b4ccf202.en: The catch is size. <bookmark mark='a'/> Dijkstra's dining philosophers: two have six states; eight have one thousand one hundred and fifty-four. Each philosopher multiplies the count by about two point four: the state explosion. <bookmark mark='b'/> For every size the checker finds the deadlock, everyone holding a left fork, in n steps. <bookmark mark='c'/> Take forks in a global order, Part 33's cure, and no deadlock is reachable. <bookmark mark='d'/> Yet a philosopher can still starve under weak fairness, though not under strong. To go further, we must stop listing states one by one.
4c38b4ccf202.zh: 问题在于规模。<bookmark mark='a'/>迪杰斯特拉的哲学家就餐问题：两位哲学家有6个状态；八位有1154个。每增加一位哲学家，状态数大约乘以2.4：这就是状态爆炸。<bookmark mark='b'/>对每一种规模，检验器都能在 n 步内找到死锁，也就是每个人都拿着左边的叉子。<bookmark mark='c'/>按一个全局顺序拿叉子，也就是第33部分的治法，就没有可以到达的死锁。<bookmark mark='d'/>但在弱公平性下，一位哲学家仍然可能陷入饥饿，在强公平性下则不会。要走得更远，我们就必须停止一个一个地列举状态。

1bf4327c0a9d.en: Chapter seven. Symbolic and bounded model checking.
1bf4327c0a9d.zh: 第七章：符号模型检验与有界模型检验。

ae5d6c22d3fe.en: Explicit checking lists states one at a time; symbolic checking describes whole sets with formulas. <bookmark mark='a'/> Give each philosopher two bits: holding its first fork, and eating. <bookmark mark='b'/> A state of three philosophers is six bits, and a set of states is a Boolean function, true exactly on its members. <bookmark mark='c'/> Moves become formulas over the current bits and a primed copy for the next. Philosopher zero may take fork zero if it is not holding it and philosopher two, who shares it, is not eating. <bookmark mark='d'/> Afterwards it holds it. <bookmark mark='e'/> Every other bit stays put. <bookmark mark='f'/> The disjunction over all commands is the whole system.
ae5d6c22d3fe.zh: 显式检验一次列出一个状态；符号检验用公式描述整个集合。<bookmark mark='a'/>给每位哲学家两个位：是否拿着他的第一把叉子，以及是否在吃饭。<bookmark mark='b'/>三位哲学家的一个状态就是六个位，而一个状态集合就是一个布尔函数，恰好在它的成员上为真。<bookmark mark='c'/>动作变成关于当前各位、以及表示下一状态的带撇副本的公式。如果哲学家零没有拿着叉子零，并且和他共用这把叉子的哲学家二没有在吃饭，哲学家零就可以拿起叉子零。<bookmark mark='d'/>之后他就拿着它。<bookmark mark='e'/>其他每一位都保持不变。<bookmark mark='f'/>所有命令的析取就是整个系统。

95a5fbd0225b.en: Part 3 built the data structure for such functions. <bookmark mark='a'/> This function of four bits says two pairs are equal. As a decision tree it needs fifteen tests. <bookmark mark='b'/> Randal Bryant's reduction, of 1986, merges identical subgraphs and skips tests whose branches agree: six nodes remain. <bookmark mark='c'/> The result is canonical: for a fixed order each function has one diagram, so comparing two sets of states is a single pointer comparison. <bookmark mark='d'/> But order matters. Read both x bits before either y bit, and the diagram must remember x one while reading x two: nine nodes.
95a5fbd0225b.zh: 第3部分为这样的函数搭建了数据结构。<bookmark mark='a'/>这个四位的函数说的是两对位分别相等。作为决策树，它需要15次测试。<bookmark mark='b'/>兰德尔·布莱恩特1986年的化简合并相同的子图，并跳过两个分支相同的测试：剩下6个结点。<bookmark mark='c'/>结果是规范的：对一个固定的顺序，每个函数只有一个图，所以比较两个状态集合只需要一次指针比较。<bookmark mark='d'/>但顺序很要紧。先读两个 x 位，再读任何一个 y 位，图在读 x2 的时候就必须记住 x1：9个结点。

103d9439d659.en: How much does order matter? <bookmark mark='a'/> Our package builds the same equality for up to twelve pairs. Interleaved, each pair costs three nodes: thirty-six in all. Separated: twelve thousand two hundred and eighty-five. <bookmark mark='b'/> With the x bits first, the diagram is a full tree over them, and every branch must remember which y values it still expects. <bookmark mark='c'/> Summing the levels gives three times two to the n, minus three. <bookmark mark='d'/> Finding the best order is NP-hard. And Bryant proved in 1991 that multiplication has no good order at all, the wall our SAT solver hit in Chapter 4.
103d9439d659.zh: 顺序到底有多要紧？<bookmark mark='a'/>我们的程序包为多达12对位构造同样的相等函数。交错排列时，每一对花3个结点：一共36个。分开排列时：12285个。<bookmark mark='b'/>x 位在前时，图在它们上面是一棵满树，每个分支都必须记住它还在等待哪些 y 值。<bookmark mark='c'/>把各层加起来，得到3乘以2的 n 次方，再减3。<bookmark mark='d'/>找到最好的顺序是 NP 难的。而布莱恩特在1991年证明了，乘法根本没有好的顺序，这正是我们的 SAT 求解器在第四章撞上的那堵墙。

fbd78c4cf295.en: Reachability becomes a loop over formulas. <bookmark mark='a'/> The image of a set, its successors, is one relational product: conjoin with the transition relation, then quantify away the current bits. <bookmark mark='b'/> The relation is kept as one small piece per command. <bookmark mark='c'/> Start from the initial states, add the image, rename, repeat; each round reaches one step further. <bookmark mark='d'/> When a round adds nothing, we have every reachable state, and canonicity makes noticing that one comparison. <bookmark mark='e'/> Sixteen philosophers take sixteen images: one million three hundred and thirty-one thousand seven hundred and fourteen states, in under a second.
fbd78c4cf295.zh: 可达性变成一个关于公式的循环。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个集合的像，也就是它的后继，是一次关系积：先与转移关系取合取，再把当前的各位量化掉。<bookmark mark='b'/>这个关系按每条命令一小块的方式保存。<bookmark mark='c'/>从初始状态开始，加上像，重命名，重复；每一轮都多走一步。<bookmark mark='d'/>当一轮什么也没加时，我们就得到了每一个可达状态，而规范性让发现这一点只需一次比较。<bookmark mark='e'/>16位哲学家需要16次求像：1331714个状态，用时不到一秒。

ce6c8de534b9.en: Here is the pay-off. <bookmark mark='a'/> In yellow, the reachable states, past a million at sixteen philosophers. In green, the diagram that holds them: it grows by just eight nodes per philosopher, to one hundred and seventeen. <bookmark mark='b'/> Up to eight philosophers the explicit checker's counts agree exactly. <bookmark mark='c'/> And the deadlock is found symbolically too. <bookmark mark='d'/> The lesson: structure, not size, decides. A ring of identical neighbours suits a BDD; a multiplier does not.
ce6c8de534b9.zh: 这就是回报。<bookmark mark='a'/>黄色的是可达状态，在16位哲学家时超过了100万。绿色的是存放它们的图：每多一位哲学家它只增加8个结点，最后是117个。<bookmark mark='b'/>直到八位哲学家，显式检验器的计数都与之完全一致。<bookmark mark='c'/>死锁也能用符号方法找到。<bookmark mark='d'/>教训是：决定成败的是结构，而不是规模。一圈相同的邻居很适合 BDD；乘法器则不然。

78876b2c1447.en: SAT solvers attack the explosion from the other side. <bookmark mark='a'/> Bounded model checking, from Biere, Cimatti, Clarke and Zhu in 1999, unrolls the transitions k times: an initial state, k steps, and a deadlock at the end. A satisfying assignment is a counterexample. <bookmark mark='b'/> For seven philosophers we try k equals zero, one, two, and so on. The refutations get harder: k equals six costs two thousand five hundred and ninety-eight conflicts. <bookmark mark='c'/> At seven the formula is satisfiable, and the decoded model is the deadlock. <bookmark mark='d'/> With ordered forks, every bound up to seven is unsatisfiable, and every reachable state lies within five steps, so that is a proof. <bookmark mark='e'/> Without a known diameter, k-induction and IC3 prove unbounded properties with the same solvers.
78876b2c1447.zh: SAT 求解器从另一边对付状态爆炸。<bookmark mark='a'/>有界模型检验由 Biere、Cimatti、克拉克和 Zhu 在1999年提出，它把转移展开 k 次：一个初始状态、k 步，最后是一个死锁。一个满足赋值就是一个反例。<bookmark mark='b'/>对七位哲学家，我们依次尝试 k 等于0、1、2，等等。驳斥越来越难：k 等于6时要花2598次冲突。<bookmark mark='c'/>到7时，公式可满足了，解码出来的模型就是那个死锁。<bookmark mark='d'/>按顺序拿叉子时，直到7的每一个界都不可满足，而每一个可达状态都在5步之内，所以这就是一个证明。<bookmark mark='e'/>在不知道直径的时候，k 归纳和 IC3 用同样的求解器证明无界的性质。

30924b38c124.en: The third way around Rice's theorem is to approximate soundly, a theory Patrick and Radhia Cousot set out in 1977. <bookmark mark='a'/> A loop with two counters reaches eleven states at its head, all on a line. <bookmark mark='b'/> Instead of exact sets, compute with simpler ones: here a box, one range per variable. <bookmark mark='c'/> The box contains every real state, so if it misses the bad states, so does the program: a proof. <bookmark mark='d'/> A coarser box may touch the bad region and raise an alarm, though no real state is bad. A sound analysis never misses a bug; the price is false alarms.
30924b38c124.zh: 绕过莱斯定理的第三条路是做可靠的近似，Patrick Cousot 和 Radhia Cousot 在1977年提出了这套理论。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个带两个计数器的循环，在它的头部到达11个状态，全都在一条直线上。<bookmark mark='b'/>不用精确的集合，而是用更简单的集合来计算：这里是一个盒子，每个变量一个范围。<bookmark mark='c'/>盒子包含每一个真实的状态，所以如果它避开了坏状态，程序也就避开了：这是一个证明。<bookmark mark='d'/>一个更粗糙的盒子可能碰到坏区域而发出警报，尽管没有哪个真实状态是坏的。可靠的分析从不漏掉错误；代价是误报。

43a60c8ebe50.en: For one variable the simpler sets are intervals, and they form a lattice. <bookmark mark='a'/> At the bottom, the empty interval, for unreachable code; at the top, all integers; each interval sits below those that contain it. <bookmark mark='b'/> Where two branches meet, intervals are joined by taking their hull, which picks up values neither branch had. <bookmark mark='c'/> Abstraction maps a set to the smallest interval holding it; concretization maps an interval back to its numbers. Together they form a Galois connection: the abstraction is the best interval possible, yet it still gains numbers. <bookmark mark='d'/> And the lattice has chains that climb for ever.
43a60c8ebe50.zh: 对一个变量，更简单的集合就是区间，它们构成一个格。<bookmark mark='a'/>最底下是空区间，对应不可达的代码；最顶上是全体整数；每个区间都位于包含它的那些区间之下。<bookmark mark='b'/>在两个分支汇合的地方，区间通过取它们的包来合并，这会拾取两个分支都没有的值。<bookmark mark='c'/>抽象把一个集合映射到包含它的最小区间；具体化把一个区间映射回它的那些数。两者一起构成一个伽罗瓦连接：抽象是可能的最好区间，但它仍然会多出一些数。<bookmark mark='d'/>而且这个格有永远向上攀升的链。

7bd989bb045a.en: What holds at a loop's head? <bookmark mark='a'/> Here x counts from zero to a hundred. At the head, x is zero on entry, or one more than a value that passed the test: an equation over intervals. <bookmark mark='b'/> Solve it by iterating from the entry state. <bookmark mark='c'/> Each round the interval grows by one: zero to zero, zero to one, zero to two. <bookmark mark='d'/> After one hundred and one rounds it stops changing. At the exit, the failed test leaves exactly a hundred, and the assertion is proved. A loop to two billion would take two billion rounds.
7bd989bb045a.zh: 在循环头部成立的是什么？<bookmark mark='a'/>这里 x 从0数到100。在头部，x 在进入时是0，或者比一个通过了测试的值大1：这是一个关于区间的方程。<bookmark mark='b'/>从进入状态开始迭代来求解它。<bookmark mark='c'/>每一轮区间增长1：0到0，0到1，0到2。<bookmark mark='d'/>101轮之后它不再变化。在出口处，失败的测试只留下恰好100，断言得证。一个到20亿的循环就要花20亿轮。

fdba5d28f844.en: Widening, also from the Cousots, forces the iteration to finish. <bookmark mark='a'/> A bound that has not moved stays; a bound that moved jumps straight to infinity. <bookmark mark='b'/> The first round moves x's upper bound from zero to one, so it jumps to infinity. <bookmark mark='c'/> The next round computes zero to a hundred, which fits inside: a fixpoint. <bookmark mark='d'/> That is too big, so narrowing runs the loop again, letting only the infinite bound come back down: zero to a hundred. <bookmark mark='e'/> Two rounds and two narrowing steps, instead of a hundred and one. On the two-counter loop, plain iteration never stops.
fdba5d28f844.zh: 加宽，同样出自 Cousot 夫妇，迫使迭代结束。<bookmark mark='a'/>没有移动过的界保持不变；移动过的界直接跳到无穷。<bookmark mark='b'/>第一轮把 x 的上界从0移到1，所以它跳到了无穷。<bookmark mark='c'/>下一轮算出0到100，它落在里面：一个不动点。<bookmark mark='d'/>这太大了，所以收窄把循环再运行一次，只让无穷的那个界降回来：0到100。<bookmark mark='e'/>两轮加上两步收窄，而不是101轮。在那个双计数器循环上，普通的迭代永远不会停。

1335d9d3e836.en: Intervals have a blind spot. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here i counts to ten and j goes up by two, so j is always twice i, and ends at twenty. <bookmark mark='b'/> Plain iteration bounds i by the test, but nothing bounds j on its own, and its interval climbs by two every round, for ever. <bookmark mark='c'/> Widening sends j to infinity, and narrowing cannot bring it back. <bookmark mark='d'/> So the assertion that j is twenty is not proved: a false alarm, on a correct program. <bookmark mark='e'/> What was lost is the relation. Relational domains keep j equal to two i, and with i equal to ten, j is twenty.
1335d9d3e836.zh: 区间有一个盲点。<bookmark mark='a'/>这里 i 数到10，j 每次加2，所以 j 总是 i 的两倍，最后是20。<bookmark mark='b'/>普通的迭代用测试给 i 定了界，但没有任何东西单独给 j 定界，它的区间每一轮往上爬2，永远爬下去。<bookmark mark='c'/>加宽把 j 送到无穷，而收窄没法把它带回来。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以 j 等于20这个断言没有得到证明：这是一个误报，出现在一个正确的程序上。<bookmark mark='e'/>丢掉的是关系。关系域保持 j 等于2i，而在 i 等于10时，j 就是20。

d66876bb49d1.en: Domains form a ladder of precision and cost. <bookmark mark='a'/> Intervals draw a box, at a cost linear in the number of variables. <bookmark mark='b'/> Antoine Miné's octagons also bound sums and differences of pairs, at cubic cost; here they cut the box to a parallelogram, but still cannot say that j is twice i. <bookmark mark='c'/> Convex polyhedra can: they shrink to the exact segment, but their operations can take exponential time. <bookmark mark='d'/> Real analysers mix domains. In 2003 Astrée, from the Cousots' group in Paris, proved automatically that the Airbus A340's flight-control software can raise no run-time error.
d66876bb49d1.zh: 抽象域构成一架精度与代价的梯子。<bookmark mark='a'/>区间画出一个盒子，代价与变量的个数成线性。<bookmark mark='b'/>Antoine Miné 的八边形还给每一对变量的和与差定界，代价是立方级的；在这里它们把盒子削成一个平行四边形，但仍然说不出 j 是 i 的两倍。<bookmark mark='c'/>凸多面体可以：它们收缩到精确的那条线段，但它们的运算可能要花指数时间。<bookmark mark='d'/>真实的分析器混合使用多种域。2003年，来自巴黎 Cousot 团队的 Astrée 自动证明了空客 A340 的飞行控制软件不会产生任何运行时错误。

453c147f9e72.en: Chapter nine. Types as lightweight proofs.
453c147f9e72.zh: 第九章：作为轻量级证明的类型。

d91351951111.en: A type checker proves a theorem about every run of a program. <bookmark mark='a'/> Picture every execution as a branch of a tree. Tests walk a few branches. <bookmark mark='b'/> A type checker reads the code once and speaks for all of them. <bookmark mark='c'/> Part 14 proved what its verdict means. Progress: a well-typed term is a value, or it can take a step. <bookmark mark='d'/> Preservation: a step keeps the type. <bookmark mark='e'/> Chain the two by induction on the number of steps, and a well-typed program never gets stuck. That is Milner's slogan: well-typed programs cannot go wrong.
d91351951111.zh: 类型检查器证明的是一个关于程序每一次运行的定理。<bookmark mark='a'/>把每一次执行想象成一棵树的一个分支。测试只走过其中几个分支。<bookmark mark='b'/>类型检查器把代码读一遍，就为所有分支作了担保。<bookmark mark='c'/>第14部分证明了它的判决意味着什么。进展性：一个良类型的项要么是一个值，要么能走一步。<bookmark mark='d'/>保持性：走一步保持类型不变。<bookmark mark='e'/>对步数做归纳，把两者串起来，一个良类型的程序就永远不会卡住。这就是米尔纳的口号：良类型的程序不会出错。

16afdb544964.en: Why is checking so cheap? <bookmark mark='a'/> A type checker is an abstract interpreter, in the sense of chapter eight: it runs the program on types instead of values. <bookmark mark='b'/> Types flow up the tree. x plus one is an int; both branches of the if are ints; so the whole expression is an int. <bookmark mark='c'/> Patrick Cousot made the connection precise in 1997. <bookmark mark='d'/> And like intervals, the abstraction loses information. This expression never goes wrong, because its condition is always true, but its two branches have different types, so it is rejected. Sound, and therefore incomplete.
16afdb544964.zh: 为什么检查这么便宜？<bookmark mark='a'/>类型检查器就是一个抽象解释器，在第八章的意义上：它在类型上而不是在值上运行程序。<bookmark mark='b'/>类型沿着树向上流动。x 加1是 int；if 的两个分支都是 int；所以整个表达式是 int。<bookmark mark='c'/>Patrick Cousot 在1997年把这种联系说得精确。<bookmark mark='d'/>而且和区间一样，这种抽象会丢失信息。这个表达式永远不会出错，因为它的条件总是为真，但它的两个分支类型不同，所以它被拒绝了。可靠，因而不完备。

a17e63bdaba6.en: Tim Freeman and Frank Pfenning introduced refinement types in 1991. <bookmark mark='a'/> A refinement type is a base type with a predicate. Int is every integer. <bookmark mark='b'/> The naturals are the integers v with v at least zero. <bookmark mark='c'/> The valid indices of an array of length n run from zero up to n, excluded. <bookmark mark='d'/> A subtype is a subset, which is an implication: whatever satisfies p satisfies q. <bookmark mark='e'/> So every index is a natural, because zero at most v below n implies zero at most v. Type checking has become logic, and the logic can go to a solver.
a17e63bdaba6.zh: Tim Freeman 和 Frank Pfenning 在1991年引入了精化类型。<bookmark mark='a'/>精化类型是一个基本类型加上一个谓词。Int 是每一个整数。<bookmark mark='b'/>自然数是满足 v 至少为零的整数 v。<bookmark mark='c'/>一个长度为 n 的数组的有效下标，从零一直到 n，不包括 n。<bookmark mark='d'/>子类型就是子集，也就是一个蕴涵：凡满足 p 的都满足 q。<bookmark mark='e'/>所以每个下标都是自然数，因为零小于等于 v 小于 n 蕴涵零小于等于 v。类型检查变成了逻辑，而逻辑可以交给求解器。

549b0d17ae10.en: The hook's midpoint, as a type. <bookmark mark='a'/> Declare low a natural and high greater than low, and demand that mid lie from low up to high, excluded. <bookmark mark='b'/> The checker gives the expression its exact type, v equals m, and asks whether that is a subtype. <bookmark mark='c'/> Under the facts in scope, that is an implication, <bookmark mark='d'/> and written out it is exactly the verification condition our SAT solver handled in chapter three. <bookmark mark='e'/> For the repaired midpoint it is valid over sixteen-bit words, so the program type-checks. <bookmark mark='f'/> For Bloch's original line the solver's counterexample becomes a type error: the bug, rejected before the program runs.
549b0d17ae10.zh: 开场时的那个中点，写成类型。<bookmark mark='a'/>声明 low 是自然数，high 大于 low，并要求 mid 位于从 low 到 high 之间，不包括 high。<bookmark mark='b'/>检查器给这个表达式它的精确类型，v 等于 m，并问这是不是一个子类型。<bookmark mark='c'/>在作用域内的事实之下，这是一个蕴涵，<bookmark mark='d'/>写出来，它恰好就是我们的 SAT 求解器在第三章处理过的那个验证条件。<bookmark mark='e'/>对修好的中点，它在16位字上有效，所以程序通过了类型检查。<bookmark mark='f'/>对 Bloch 原来的那一行，求解器的反例变成了一个类型错误：这个错误在程序运行之前就被拒绝了。

987b4d9a2b45.en: Liquid types, from Patrick Rondon, Ming Kawaguchi and Ranjit Jhala in 2008, infer refinements. <bookmark mark='a'/> The loop counter's type is an unknown, K. The programmer supplies candidate facts, called qualifiers. <bookmark mark='b'/> Start by assuming all of them. On entry i is zero, which need not be less than n, so that one goes. <bookmark mark='c'/> Round the loop, i plus one is not zero, so that one goes too. Another round removes nothing: a fixpoint, as in chapter eight. <bookmark mark='d'/> So i lies from zero to n, and with the loop's test every access to a of i is in bounds, with no annotation on the loop.
987b4d9a2b45.zh: 液态类型（Liquid Types）由 Patrick Rondon、Ming Kawaguchi 和 Ranjit Jhala 在2008年提出，它能推断精化。<bookmark mark='a'/>循环计数器的类型是一个未知量 K。程序员提供候选事实，叫作限定词。<bookmark mark='b'/>一开始假定它们全都成立。进入时 i 是零，而零不一定小于 n，所以那一条被去掉。<bookmark mark='c'/>绕循环一圈，i 加1不是零，所以那一条也被去掉。再一轮什么也没去掉：一个不动点，就像第八章那样。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以 i 位于从零到 n 之间，再加上循环的测试，每一次对 a 的第 i 个元素的访问都在界内，而循环上没有任何标注。

1bfce26aa38e.en: Types form a ladder. <bookmark mark='a'/> Simple types, like those of Part 14 and of our own compiler's checker, cost almost nothing and rule out stuck programs. <bookmark mark='b'/> Ownership types, Rust's, to which Part 55 returns, rule out use after free and data races in safe code. <bookmark mark='c'/> Refinement types, in LiquidHaskell and F star, prove bounds and invariants, with a solver doing the work. <bookmark mark='d'/> At the top, dependent types can state full functional correctness, and the programmer writes the proof. There a type checker is a proof checker, which is the next chapter's subject.
1bfce26aa38e.zh: 类型构成一架梯子。<bookmark mark='a'/>简单类型，比如第14部分的那些，以及我们自己编译器的检查器所用的，几乎不花代价，就排除了会卡住的程序。<bookmark mark='b'/>所有权类型，也就是 Rust 的那种，第55部分会再谈到它，在安全代码中排除了释放后使用和数据竞争。<bookmark mark='c'/>精化类型，在 LiquidHaskell 和 F* 中，证明边界和不变量，由求解器来做这些工作。<bookmark mark='d'/>在最顶上，依赖类型可以陈述完整的功能正确性，而由程序员来写证明。在那里，类型检查器就是证明检查器，这正是下一章的主题。

d0d587a59876.en: In 1972 Robin Milner built LCF, a program for checking proofs that could be trusted without trusting most of it. <bookmark mark='a'/> A theorem is a value of an abstract type, and only the inference rules, gathered in a small kernel, can make one. <bookmark mark='b'/> Everything else, tactics, proof search, scripts, the user, can call the rules but cannot forge a result. <bookmark mark='c'/> Here is one rule of our own kernel: modus ponens checks that the second premise is the antecedent of the first, or refuses. Our kernel has sixty-nine lines and eleven rules. <bookmark mark='d'/> For Edinburgh LCF, Milner's group designed a language for writing tactics: ML, the ancestor of Standard ML and OCaml.
d0d587a59876.zh: 1972年，罗宾·米尔纳构建了 LCF，一个检查证明的程序，人们无需信任它的大部分，就能信任它。<bookmark mark='a'/>定理是一种抽象类型的值，只有推理规则才能造出它，而这些规则集中在一个小小的内核里。<bookmark mark='b'/>其他一切，策略、证明搜索、脚本、用户，都可以调用这些规则，却无法伪造结果。<bookmark mark='c'/>这是我们自己内核里的一条规则：肯定前件式检查第二个前提是不是第一个前提的前件，不是就拒绝。我们的内核有69行、11条规则。<bookmark mark='d'/>为了 Edinburgh LCF，米尔纳的小组设计了一种写策略的语言：ML，它是 Standard ML 和 OCaml 的祖先。

1f4fde5a850f.en: The kernel's logic is natural deduction, Gerhard Gentzen's system from the 1930s. A sequent says: from these hypotheses, this conclusion. <bookmark mark='a'/> Assumption starts every proof: A, from A. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each connective has a rule to introduce it and one to use it. Implication is introduced by discharging a hypothesis, and used by modus ponens. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then conjunction, disjunction, and falsehood, from which anything follows. <bookmark mark='d'/> The eleventh rule, double negation, is the only classical one; without it the logic is intuitionistic, the logic of Part 14's programs.
1f4fde5a850f.zh: 内核的逻辑是自然演绎，这是 Gerhard Gentzen 在20世纪30年代提出的系统。一个相继式是说：由这些假设，得出这个结论。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个证明都从假设规则开始：由 A，得 A。<bookmark mark='b'/>每个联结词都有一条引入它的规则和一条使用它的规则。蕴涵通过解除一个假设来引入，通过肯定前件式来使用。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后是合取、析取，以及假，由它可以推出任何东西。<bookmark mark='d'/>第十一条规则，双重否定，是唯一的经典规则；没有它，这个逻辑就是直觉主义的，也就是第14部分那些程序的逻辑。

e8e6509f9b1d.en: Here is a proof our kernel made: A and B implies B and A. <bookmark mark='a'/> It starts from one assumption, A and B, used twice. <bookmark mark='b'/> The elimination rules take it apart, into B and into A. <bookmark mark='c'/> Introduction puts them together the other way round. <bookmark mark='d'/> Discharging the assumption leaves the theorem with no hypotheses, after five kernel calls, and a truth table agrees. <bookmark mark='e'/> In Lean the proof is one line, which Lean's kernel checks as a typed program: Part 14's propositions as types.
e8e6509f9b1d.zh: 这是我们的内核造出的一个证明：A 且 B 蕴涵 B 且 A。<bookmark mark='a'/>它从一个假设 A 且 B 出发，用了两次。<bookmark mark='b'/>消去规则把它拆开，得到 B 和 A。<bookmark mark='c'/>引入规则把它们反过来重新组合。<bookmark mark='d'/>解除这个假设，留下一个没有任何假设的定理，一共调用了五次内核，真值表也与之一致。<bookmark mark='e'/>在 Lean 中，这个证明只有一行，Lean 的内核把它当作一个有类型的程序来检查：这就是第14部分的命题即类型。

1d4c940ca365.en: Every illegal step is refused. <bookmark mark='a'/> Making a theorem directly, without a rule. <bookmark mark='b'/> Modus ponens, with the wrong antecedent. <bookmark mark='c'/> Taking apart a conjunction that is really an implication. <bookmark mark='d'/> Double negation, applied to a single negation. <bookmark mark='e'/> And editing the conclusion of a finished theorem. Each stops at the kernel with a message. <bookmark mark='f'/> One caution: Python cannot seal a type the way ML can, so our guard stops honest mistakes, not a determined forger. Serious systems also meet what is called the de Bruijn criterion: their proofs can be rechecked by a small, independent program.
1d4c940ca365.zh: 每一个非法步骤都会被拒绝。<bookmark mark='a'/>不经规则直接造出一个定理。<bookmark mark='b'/>前件不对的肯定前件式。<bookmark mark='c'/>拆开一个其实是蕴涵的合取。<bookmark mark='d'/>把双重否定用在单重否定上。<bookmark mark='e'/>以及修改一个已经完成的定理的结论。每一种都在内核处被拦下，并给出一条消息。<bookmark mark='f'/>需要提醒一点：Python 没法像 ML 那样封住一个类型，所以我们的守卫拦得住诚实的错误，却拦不住一心伪造的人。严肃的系统还满足所谓的德布鲁因准则：它们的证明可以由一个小而独立的程序重新检查。

149c120f7923.en: Proof assistants trust their kernels in one of two ways. <bookmark mark='a'/> In the LCF style, as in HOL Light and Isabelle, a theorem is an abstract value that only the kernel's rules can make; HOL Light's kernel is a few hundred lines. <bookmark mark='b'/> In the other, as in Rocq, called Coq until 2025, and in Lean, a tactic builds a proof term, which is a program, and a small kernel type-checks it. <bookmark mark='c'/> Either way, what sits above the kernel can be enormous, automated and wrong, and the result can still be trusted, which is why the frontier chapter can let language models write proofs.
149c120f7923.zh: 证明助手以两种方式之一信任它们的内核。<bookmark mark='a'/>在 LCF 风格中，比如 HOL Light 和 Isabelle，定理是一个只有内核规则才能造出的抽象值；HOL Light 的内核只有几百行。<bookmark mark='b'/>在另一种方式中，比如 Rocq，它在2025年之前叫 Coq，以及 Lean，策略构造出一个证明项，它就是一个程序，再由一个小内核对它做类型检查。<bookmark mark='c'/>无论哪种方式，内核之上的东西都可以庞大、自动化，甚至出错，而结果仍然可以信任，这就是为什么前沿那一章可以让语言模型来写证明。

33c57fe79f7c.en: Proof assistants now check real mathematics. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 1976 Kenneth Appel and Wolfgang Haken proved the four colour theorem with a computer checking many cases, and many mathematicians were uneasy. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 2005 Georges Gonthier, with Benjamin Werner, completed a proof checked end to end in Coq. <bookmark mark='c'/> Thomas Hales's 1998 proof of the Kepler conjecture also leaned on computation; his Flyspeck project finished a formal proof in HOL Light and Isabelle in 2014. <bookmark mark='d'/> In 2012 Gonthier's team checked the odd order theorem, and in 2022 Lean's users finished the Liquid Tensor Experiment, Peter Scholze's challenge, on top of mathlib, which AI, Built met in Part 25.
33c57fe79f7c.zh: 证明助手如今已在检查真正的数学。<bookmark mark='a'/>1976年，肯尼斯·阿佩尔和沃尔夫冈·哈肯借助一台检查大量情形的计算机证明了四色定理，许多数学家对此感到不安。<bookmark mark='b'/>2005年，Georges Gonthier 与 Benjamin Werner 一起完成了一个在 Coq 中从头到尾检查过的证明。<bookmark mark='c'/>Thomas Hales 1998年对开普勒猜想的证明同样依赖计算；他的 Flyspeck 项目在2014年用 HOL Light 和 Isabelle 完成了一个形式化证明。<bookmark mark='d'/>2012年，Gonthier 的团队检查了奇阶定理；2022年，Lean 的用户们在 mathlib 之上完成了液态张量实验，那是 Peter Scholze 提出的挑战，而 mathlib 我们在《人工智能，从零搭建》的第25部分见过。

319c97021012.zh: 第十一章：经过验证的系统。

4b845266df05.en: CompCert, from Xavier Leroy and colleagues at Inria, is a C compiler with a theorem; Leroy described its verified back end in 2006. <bookmark mark='a'/> It translates C through a chain of intermediate languages to assembly, optimizing in the middle, on a language called RTL. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each pass is written in Coq with a proof: if it produces output, every behaviour of the output is a behaviour of its input. <bookmark mark='c'/> Inclusion is transitive, so the proofs chain. <bookmark mark='d'/> For a source program with no undefined behaviour, the assembly can only do what the C could do.
4b845266df05.zh: CompCert 出自泽维尔·勒鲁瓦和他在 Inria 的同事之手，是一个带着定理的 C 编译器；勒鲁瓦在2006年描述了它经过验证的后端。<bookmark mark='a'/>它把 C 经过一连串中间语言翻译成汇编，在中间一种叫 RTL 的语言上做优化。<bookmark mark='b'/>每一遍都用 Coq 写成，并带有证明：如果它产生了输出，那么输出的每一种行为都是它输入的一种行为。<bookmark mark='c'/>包含关系是传递的，所以这些证明可以串起来。<bookmark mark='d'/>对一个没有未定义行为的源程序，汇编只能做 C 本来能做的事。

855cad1b4bca.en: In 2011 John Regehr's group at the University of Utah published Csmith, which generates random C programs with no undefined behaviour, and compared what compilers made of them. <bookmark mark='a'/> In GCC and LLVM it found hundreds of unknown bugs, many of them silent wrong code. <bookmark mark='b'/> In CompCert's verified middle it found no wrong-code bugs at all. <bookmark mark='c'/> The bugs it did find in CompCert were outside the proof, in parts such as the unverified front end. <bookmark mark='d'/> The proof did its job, and testing showed where the proof ended.
855cad1b4bca.zh: 2011年，犹他大学 John Regehr 的小组发布了 Csmith，它生成没有未定义行为的随机 C 程序，并比较编译器把它们变成了什么。<bookmark mark='a'/>它在 GCC 和 LLVM 中发现了数百个未知的错误，其中许多会悄无声息地生成错误的代码。<bookmark mark='b'/>在 CompCert 经过验证的中间部分，它一个生成错误代码的缺陷也没有找到。<bookmark mark='c'/>它在 CompCert 中确实找到的那些错误，都在证明之外，在诸如未经验证的前端这样的部分。<bookmark mark='d'/>证明完成了它的任务，而测试显示了证明在哪里结束。

8f6c677aad8c.en: In 2009 Gerwin Klein and his colleagues at NICTA in Sydney proved the seL4 microkernel correct. <bookmark mark='a'/> An abstract specification says what each system call does. <bookmark mark='b'/> An executable specification, translated from a Haskell prototype, refines it. <bookmark mark='c'/> The C code, about eight thousand seven hundred lines, refines that, in a proof of about two hundred thousand lines of Isabelle. <bookmark mark='d'/> The 2009 proof assumed the compiler, about six hundred lines of assembly, the boot code and the hardware. <bookmark mark='e'/> In 2013 the compiled binary was checked against the C, taking the compiler off that list, by a technique chapter fourteen returns to.
8f6c677aad8c.zh: 2009年，Gerwin Klein 和他在悉尼 NICTA 的同事证明了 seL4 微内核是正确的。<bookmark mark='a'/>一份抽象规约说明每个系统调用做什么。<bookmark mark='b'/>一份可执行规约，从一个 Haskell 原型翻译而来，精化了它。<bookmark mark='c'/>C 代码大约8700行，又精化了可执行规约，证明用 Isabelle 写了大约20万行。<bookmark mark='d'/>2009年的证明假定了编译器、大约600行汇编、启动代码和硬件都是正确的。<bookmark mark='e'/>2013年，编译出来的二进制文件被拿来与 C 对照检查，把编译器从那张清单上去掉了，所用的技术第十四章会再讲到。

356c73ef881b.en: Both proofs rest on one picture, the simulation square. <bookmark mark='a'/> Relate each concrete state to an abstract one. <bookmark mark='b'/> When the concrete machine takes a step, <bookmark mark='c'/> the abstract machine must be able to match it and keep the relation, <bookmark mark='d'/> or stand still, a stutter, when the concrete step is internal bookkeeping. <bookmark mark='e'/> Tile the squares along a run, by induction, and every concrete run is shadowed by an abstract one, so every safety property of the specification holds of the code. The next chapter checks exactly this for a protocol.
356c73ef881b.zh: 这两个证明都建立在同一幅图上：模拟方块。<bookmark mark='a'/>把每个具体状态与一个抽象状态联系起来。<bookmark mark='b'/>当具体机器走一步时，<bookmark mark='c'/>抽象机器必须能够匹配这一步，并保持这种关系，<bookmark mark='d'/>或者原地不动，也就是踏步（stutter），在具体的这一步只是内部簿记的时候。<bookmark mark='e'/>沿着一次运行把方块一块块铺下去，做归纳，每一次具体运行就都有一次抽象运行如影随形，所以规约的每一条安全性质对代码都成立。下一章恰好对一个协议检查这一点。

716304e9e6d9.en: Cryptography is the code most worth proving. <bookmark mark='a'/> In Curve25519's field, the specification of multiplication is one line: multiply, then reduce modulo p, <bookmark mark='b'/> which is two to the two hundred and fifty-five, minus nineteen. <bookmark mark='c'/> So a carry past bit two hundred and fifty-five comes back as nineteen. <bookmark mark='d'/> Fast code splits each number into five fifty-one-bit limbs, <bookmark mark='e'/> and a limb product that reaches that bit wraps round as nineteen times itself: the code is full of nineteens. <bookmark mark='f'/> Fiat-Crypto generates such code from the specification, with a Coq proof. HACL star proves memory safety, correctness, and that no branch or address depends on a secret, closing Part 29's timing channels.
716304e9e6d9.zh: 密码学代码是最值得证明的代码。<bookmark mark='a'/>在 Curve25519 的域中，乘法的规约只有一行：相乘，然后模 p 约简，<bookmark mark='b'/>p 是2的255次方减19。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以越过第255位的进位会以19的形式回来。<bookmark mark='d'/>快速代码把每个数拆成五个51位的分块（limb），<bookmark mark='e'/>而一个到达那一位的分块乘积会以它自身的19倍绕回来：代码里满是19。<bookmark mark='f'/>Fiat-Crypto 从规约生成这样的代码，并附带 Coq 证明。HACL* 证明了内存安全、正确性，以及没有任何分支或地址依赖于秘密，从而堵上了第29部分的计时信道。

cd661d1ed471.en: CakeML, from Ramana Kumar, Magnus Myreen, Michael Norrish and Scott Owens in 2014, closes another gap. <bookmark mark='a'/> CompCert proves the compiler's source. <bookmark mark='b'/> But its Coq functions are extracted to OCaml and compiled by an unverified compiler. <bookmark mark='c'/> CakeML's compiler, proved in the HOL4 prover, was run inside the logic on its own source, so its machine code comes with the proof. <bookmark mark='d'/> What is left is short: the proof checker's kernel, the hardware model, and the specification. Whether the specification says what we meant, no proof can answer, and Part 55 asks what happens when the compiler binary is the enemy.
cd661d1ed471.zh: CakeML 由 Ramana Kumar、Magnus Myreen、Michael Norrish 和 Scott Owens 在2014年推出，它填补了另一个缺口。<bookmark mark='a'/>CompCert 证明的是编译器的源代码。<bookmark mark='b'/>但它的 Coq 函数被提取成 OCaml，再由一个未经验证的编译器编译。<bookmark mark='c'/>CakeML 的编译器在 HOL4 证明器中得到证明，并在逻辑内部对它自己的源代码运行，所以它的机器码是带着证明来的。<bookmark mark='d'/>剩下的已经很短：证明检查器的内核、硬件模型，以及规约。规约是否说出了我们的本意，任何证明都回答不了，而第55部分会问，当编译器二进制文件本身就是敌人时会发生什么。

7272f64f87f9.en: Chapter twelve. Specifying systems with TLA plus.
7272f64f87f9.zh: 第十二章：用 TLA+ 为系统写规约。

8b2988a898e5.en: Leslie Lamport's temporal logic of actions, TLA, from 1994, describes a system as a state machine written in ordinary mathematics. <bookmark mark='a'/> A state gives a value to every variable; a behaviour is an infinite sequence of states. <bookmark mark='b'/> A specification is a formula true of the right behaviours. It starts in an initial state, <bookmark mark='c'/> and always, each step satisfies the next-state relation, <bookmark mark='d'/> or leaves the variables unchanged: a stutter, which lets a finer-grained implementation take steps of its own. <bookmark mark='e'/> Fairness adds that something good eventually happens. TLA plus is the language built around this formula, and TLC is its model checker.
8b2988a898e5.zh: 莱斯利·兰波特的动作时序逻辑 TLA 出自1994年，它把一个系统描述成一台用普通数学写成的状态机。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个状态给每个变量一个值；一个行为是一个无限的状态序列。<bookmark mark='b'/>规约是一个公式，它对正确的那些行为为真。它从一个初始状态开始，<bookmark mark='c'/>并且总是每一步都满足次态关系，<bookmark mark='d'/>或者保持变量不变：这就是踏步，它让一个粒度更细的实现可以走它自己的步。<bookmark mark='e'/>公平性再补上一条：某件好事最终会发生。TLA+ 是围绕这个公式构建的语言，而 TLC 是它的模型检验器。

b28d405528e2.en: Jim Gray and Leslie Lamport's TCommit says what commit means. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each resource manager starts working, may prepare, then commits or aborts. <bookmark mark='b'/> It may commit only when every manager is prepared or committed, and abort only when nobody has committed. <bookmark mark='c'/> The property we want is consistency: never one committed and another aborted. <bookmark mark='d'/> How many states are reachable? Either nobody has committed, and each manager is working, prepared or aborted: three to the n. <bookmark mark='e'/> Or someone has, and all are prepared or committed, at least one committed: two to the n, minus one. <bookmark mark='f'/> Our checker agrees for two to five managers.
b28d405528e2.zh: Jim Gray 和莱斯利·兰波特的 TCommit 说明了提交是什么意思。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个资源管理器从工作状态开始，可以准备，然后提交或中止。<bookmark mark='b'/>只有当每个管理器都已准备或已提交时，它才可以提交；只有当谁都没有提交时，它才可以中止。<bookmark mark='c'/>我们想要的性质是一致性：永远不会一个已提交而另一个已中止。<bookmark mark='d'/>有多少个可达状态？要么谁都没有提交，每个管理器处于工作、已准备或已中止：3的 n 次方。<bookmark mark='e'/>要么有人提交了，所有管理器都已准备或已提交，并且至少有一个已提交：2的 n 次方减1。<bookmark mark='f'/>我们的检验器对两到五个管理器都与此一致。

e38526d1bb14.en: Two-phase commit, the protocol, adds a transaction manager and messages. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each resource manager that is ready prepares, and sends a Prepared message. <bookmark mark='b'/> The transaction manager collects them, and when every one has prepared, it decides to commit and sends Commit. <bookmark mark='c'/> Each resource manager that receives it commits. As in Lamport's specification, messages are never lost: once sent, a message stays in the bag. <bookmark mark='d'/> The checker explores every interleaving: two hundred and eighty-eight states for three managers, eight thousand eight hundred and thirty-two for five, and consistency holds in all of them.
e38526d1bb14.zh: 两阶段提交这个协议，加上了一个事务管理器和消息。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个就绪的资源管理器进行准备，并发出一条 Prepared 消息。<bookmark mark='b'/>事务管理器收集这些消息，当每一个都已准备时，它决定提交，并发出 Commit。<bookmark mark='c'/>每个收到它的资源管理器就提交。和兰波特的规约一样，消息永远不会丢失：一条消息一旦发出，就一直留在袋子里。<bookmark mark='d'/>检验器探索每一种交错：三个管理器时288个状态，五个时8832个，而一致性在所有这些状态里都成立。

a82d3815a415.en: Now plant a bug that looks like good engineering: a timeout. <bookmark mark='a'/> If the coordinator has waited too long, it commits without hearing from everyone. <bookmark mark='b'/> With three managers the checker explores six hundred and twenty-three states and returns a counterexample of three steps. <bookmark mark='c'/> The coordinator times out, and commits before anyone has prepared. <bookmark mark='d'/> Resource manager zero, still working, chooses to abort, as it is allowed to. <bookmark mark='e'/> Resource manager one receives Commit, and commits. One committed and one aborted: the invariant is broken. A coordinator that times out may abort, never commit.
a82d3815a415.zh: 现在植入一个看起来像是良好工程实践的错误：超时。<bookmark mark='a'/>如果协调者等得太久，它就不等所有人回音，直接提交。<bookmark mark='b'/>三个管理器时，检验器探索了623个状态，返回一个三步的反例。<bookmark mark='c'/>协调者超时了，在任何人准备之前就提交了。<bookmark mark='d'/>资源管理器零还在工作，它选择中止，这是它被允许的。<bookmark mark='e'/>资源管理器一收到 Commit，于是提交。一个已提交，一个已中止：不变量被打破了。超时的协调者可以中止，但绝不能提交。

9fa100e97d14.en: Is the protocol a correct implementation of the specification? In TLA, implementation is implication. <bookmark mark='a'/> Map each protocol state to its resource managers' states, forgetting the coordinator and the messages. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then every protocol step must be a TCommit step, or leave the managers unchanged. Preparing and committing map to TCommit's own steps; the coordinator's bookkeeping maps to stutters, which is exactly why TLA allows them. <bookmark mark='c'/> Our checker tried every reachable step for two, three and four managers: the protocol refines the specification. <bookmark mark='d'/> So its consistency follows from TCommit's, by chapter eleven's square, and so does every other safety property that TCommit has.
9fa100e97d14.zh: 这个协议是规约的一个正确实现吗？在 TLA 中，实现就是蕴涵。<bookmark mark='a'/>把每个协议状态映射到它的资源管理器的状态，忘掉协调者和消息。<bookmark mark='b'/>那么每一个协议步骤都必须是一个 TCommit 步骤，或者保持管理器不变。准备和提交映射到 TCommit 自己的步骤；协调者的簿记映射到踏步，这正是 TLA 允许踏步的原因。<bookmark mark='c'/>我们的检验器对两个、三个和四个管理器尝试了每一个可达的步骤：协议精化了规约。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以它的一致性由 TCommit 的一致性推出，靠的是第十一章的方块，TCommit 具有的其他每一条安全性质也是如此。

385f15165fb8.en: A model checker covers small instances only. <bookmark mark='a'/> The protocol's states grow about five-fold with each manager, to eight thousand eight hundred and thirty-two at five. <bookmark mark='b'/> But the timeout bug needed only three managers and three steps. Daniel Jackson's small scope hypothesis says this is typical: most design bugs have small counterexamples. <bookmark mark='c'/> For every n, TLA plus has a proof system, TLAPS, in which invariants are proved by induction, like the loops of chapter two. <bookmark mark='d'/> Engineers at Amazon and Microsoft have described finding design bugs this way before writing code, as the frontier chapter tells.
385f15165fb8.zh: 模型检验器只覆盖小的实例。<bookmark mark='a'/>协议的状态数每多一个管理器大约增长到五倍，到五个时是8832个。<bookmark mark='b'/>但超时错误只需要三个管理器和三步。Daniel Jackson 的小范围假设说这是典型的：大多数设计错误都有很小的反例。<bookmark mark='c'/>对每一个 n，TLA+ 都有一个证明系统 TLAPS，在其中，不变量通过归纳来证明，就像第二章的那些循环。<bookmark mark='d'/>Amazon 和微软的工程师都讲述过，他们在写代码之前就用这种方法发现了设计错误，前沿那一章会讲到这些。

48ad41b44ff5.zh: 第十三章：作为科学的测试。

7d4fc953c14c.en: Coverage measures where the tests have been. <bookmark mark='a'/> Glenford Myers's triangle classifier, from his 1979 book on testing, takes three sides and names the triangle. <bookmark mark='b'/> Run three hundred random tests, with sides from one to a hundred. <bookmark mark='c'/> They reach seven of the nine lines, and six of the eight branch outcomes. <bookmark mark='d'/> Two lines never ran. No side was ever zero or negative, and no triangle was equilateral: with random sides, all three agree once in ten thousand draws. Coverage points at exactly what the tests missed.
7d4fc953c14c.zh: 覆盖率衡量的是测试到过哪里。<bookmark mark='a'/>Glenford Myers 在他1979年那本讲测试的书里给出的三角形分类器，接受三条边，说出三角形的类型。<bookmark mark='b'/>运行300个随机测试，边长从1到100。<bookmark mark='c'/>它们运行到了9行中的7行，以及8个分支结果中的6个。<bookmark mark='d'/>有两行从没运行过。没有哪条边是零或负数，也没有哪个三角形是等边的：边长随机时，一万次抽取里才有一次三条边全都相等。覆盖率恰好指出了测试漏掉了什么。

deee42b25cd7.en: Full coverage proves less than it seems. <bookmark mark='a'/> This insert puts a number into a sorted list, and its scan stops one element early. <bookmark mark='b'/> Three unit tests pass, <bookmark mark='c'/> and between them they run every line and both outcomes of the loop test: full coverage. <bookmark mark='d'/> A property test checks that the output is ordered and holds the right elements. It fails on its ninth random input, shrunk to inserting one into the list holding zero, and the answer comes out one, zero. Coverage says where tests have been, not that what they saw was right.
deee42b25cd7.zh: 完全覆盖证明的东西比看上去要少。<bookmark mark='a'/>这个 insert 把一个数插入一个有序列表，而它的扫描早停了一个元素。<bookmark mark='b'/>三个单元测试都通过了，<bookmark mark='c'/>而且它们加起来运行了每一行，以及循环测试的两种结果：完全覆盖。<bookmark mark='d'/>一个性质测试检查输出是否有序，并且包含正确的元素。它在第9个随机输入上失败了，收缩成把1插入只含0的列表，而得到的答案是1、0。覆盖率说明测试到过哪里，却不能说明它们看到的东西是对的。

f74db55f44fa.en: Mutation testing, proposed by Richard DeMillo, Richard Lipton and Frederick Sayward in 1978, asks whether the tests would notice a bug. <bookmark mark='a'/> Make small changes to the correct program: each is a mutant. <bookmark mark='b'/> Stopping the scan one early survives the unit tests; it is the very bug they missed. <bookmark mark='c'/> Less-or-equal survives too, but no test could kill it: inserting before or after an equal element gives the same list. It is an equivalent mutant. <bookmark mark='d'/> Greater-than is killed by two tests. <bookmark mark='e'/> Stepping by two survives. <bookmark mark='f'/> The score is killed over non-equivalent mutants: one in three. The tests are weak, and now we know where.
f74db55f44fa.zh: 变异测试由 Richard DeMillo、Richard Lipton 和 Frederick Sayward 在1978年提出，它问的是：测试会不会注意到一个错误。<bookmark mark='a'/>对正确的程序做一些小改动：每一个都是一个变异体。<bookmark mark='b'/>让扫描早停一个，这个变异体在单元测试下存活了；它正是测试漏掉的那个错误。<bookmark mark='c'/>小于等于也存活了，但没有哪个测试能杀死它：插在一个相等元素的前面还是后面，得到的列表都一样。它是一个等价变异体。<bookmark mark='d'/>大于被两个测试杀死了。<bookmark mark='e'/>步长为2的那个存活了。<bookmark mark='f'/>分数是被杀死的数目除以非等价变异体的数目：三分之一。这些测试很弱，而现在我们知道弱在哪里。

c59f79906164.en: Property-based testing replaces examples with laws; Koen Claessen and John Hughes's QuickCheck made it practical in 2000. <bookmark mark='a'/> The law for a sort: the output is in order, and rearranges the input. <bookmark mark='b'/> Random lists come small ones first. This sort goes through a set, and the twenty-seventh list breaks it: three, minus three, minus three, one. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then it shrinks. Without the three, still failing. <bookmark mark='d'/> Without the one, still failing. <bookmark mark='e'/> Both copies of minus three move toward zero together: zero, zero. <bookmark mark='f'/> After eleven candidates the report is the smallest failing case: sorting zero, zero returns one zero.
c59f79906164.zh: 基于性质的测试用定律代替例子；Koen Claessen 和 John Hughes 的 QuickCheck 在2000年让它变得实用。<bookmark mark='a'/>排序的定律是：输出是有序的，并且是输入的重新排列。<bookmark mark='b'/>随机列表从小的开始生成。这个排序要经过一个集合，而第27个列表打破了它：3、负3、负3、1。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后它开始收缩。去掉3，仍然失败。<bookmark mark='d'/>去掉1，仍然失败。<bookmark mark='e'/>两个负3一起向零移动：0、0。<bookmark mark='f'/>尝试了11个候选之后，报告的是最小的失败用例：对0、0排序，返回一个0。

874a5f6cc80b.en: In 1990 Barton Miller's students fed random characters to Unix utilities, and crashed or hung about a quarter to a third of them. <bookmark mark='a'/> But pure random input rarely gets deep. To reach this crash it must guess three bytes at once, about one chance in seventeen million. <bookmark mark='b'/> Michał Zalewski's American Fuzzy Lop, in 2013, watches which branches each input takes. <bookmark mark='c'/> An input that reaches a new branch is kept, and mutated further. The F is found, then the U, then the Z, a few hundred tries each. <bookmark mark='d'/> Since 2016 Google's OSS-Fuzz has run such fuzzers continuously on open-source projects.
874a5f6cc80b.zh: 1990年，Barton Miller 的学生把随机字符喂给 Unix 的工具程序，让其中大约四分之一到三分之一崩溃或挂起。<bookmark mark='a'/>但纯随机的输入很少能深入下去。要到达这个崩溃，它必须一次猜中三个字节，机会大约是1700万分之一。<bookmark mark='b'/>Michał Zalewski 2013年的 American Fuzzy Lop 观察每个输入走了哪些分支。<bookmark mark='c'/>一个到达新分支的输入会被保留下来，并进一步变异。先找到 F，再找到 U，然后是 Z，每个只要几百次尝试。<bookmark mark='d'/>从2016年起，Google 的 OSS-Fuzz 就在开源项目上持续不断地运行这样的模糊测试器。

5d2af9ea630d.en: Symbolic execution runs the program on symbols instead of numbers. <bookmark mark='a'/> At each branch the path splits, and each path collects a condition. <bookmark mark='b'/> To reach equilateral, no side may be zero or negative, <bookmark mark='c'/> the sides must make a real triangle, <bookmark mark='d'/> and they must be equal. <bookmark mark='e'/> Simplified: three equal, positive sides. A solver returns one, one, one, the test that three hundred random ones missed. <bookmark mark='f'/> KLEE, in 2008, did this for real C programs. Concolic testing, from DART in 2005, runs concretely, then solves for the branch not taken. The limit is the number of paths, which multiplies with every branch and loop.
