5d2af9ea630d.zh: 符号执行在符号而不是数字上运行程序。<bookmark mark='a'/>在每个分支处，路径一分为二，每条路径收集一个条件。<bookmark mark='b'/>要到达等边，没有哪条边可以是零或负数，<bookmark mark='c'/>三条边必须构成一个真正的三角形，<bookmark mark='d'/>而且它们必须相等。<bookmark mark='e'/>化简之后：三条相等的正边。求解器返回1、1、1，正是那300个随机测试漏掉的测试。<bookmark mark='f'/>2008年的 KLEE 对真实的 C 程序做到了这一点。混合执行测试（concolic testing）出自2005年的 DART，它先具体地运行，再为没走的那个分支求解。极限在于路径的数目，它随每一个分支和循环成倍增长。

6975221072db.en: Chapter fourteen. Fuzzing and validating our compiler.
6975221072db.zh: 第十四章：对我们的编译器做模糊测试与确认。

e7afaa9004cd.en: <bookmark mark='a'/> Part 13's generator writes random Pebble programs that are always well defined, so every correct implementation prints the same bytes. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each runs on the IR interpreter, which says what it means, and compiled at all four levels on the emulator. <bookmark mark='c'/> Now plant a bug: the SCCP pass's constant folder divides by Python's rule, rounding down, not Pebble's, which truncates toward zero. <bookmark mark='d'/> Both rules satisfy a equals q b plus r. <bookmark mark='e'/> For minus seven over two hundred and fifty-six, truncation gives zero, remainder minus seven; <bookmark mark='f'/> rounding down gives minus one, remainder two hundred and forty-nine.
e7afaa9004cd.zh: <bookmark mark='a'/>第13部分的生成器写出随机的 Pebble 程序，它们总是有良好定义的，所以每一个正确的实现都会打印出同样的字节。<bookmark mark='b'/>每个程序都在 IR 解释器上运行，由它规定程序的含义，再在全部四个级别上编译，在模拟器上运行。<bookmark mark='c'/>现在植入一个错误：SCCP 遍的常量折叠器按 Python 的规则做除法，向下取整，而不是按 Pebble 的规则，向零截断。<bookmark mark='d'/>两种规则都满足 a 等于 q 乘 b 加 r。<bookmark mark='e'/>对负7除以256，截断给出0，余数负7；<bookmark mark='f'/>向下取整给出负1，余数249。

b55cef318bdc.en: Then we hunt. <bookmark mark='a'/> Program by program, the fuzzer generates and compares; one program did not finish within the step limit and was skipped. <bookmark mark='b'/> The fifth, seed four, disagrees: seventy-five lines, six functions, ninety-two bytes of output. <bookmark mark='c'/> Levels zero, one and two print what the interpreter prints; level three differs from byte one on. <bookmark mark='d'/> Level three inlines, so a call's argument becomes a constant, and the broken folder divides it. <bookmark mark='e'/> With the bug removed, every program tried agrees at every level: the fuzzer found the bug, not noise.
b55cef318bdc.zh: 然后我们开始搜寻。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个程序接一个程序，模糊测试器生成并比较；有一个程序没能在步数上限内结束，被跳过了。<bookmark mark='b'/>第五个，种子4，出现了不一致：75行，6个函数，92字节的输出。<bookmark mark='c'/>第零级、第一级和第二级打印的和解释器一样；第三级从第一个字节起就不同。<bookmark mark='d'/>第三级会做内联，于是一次调用的参数变成了常量，而坏掉的折叠器对它做了除法。<bookmark mark='e'/>去掉这个错误后，试过的每个程序在每个级别上都一致：模糊测试器找到的是这个错误，而不是噪声。

b918919a92b8.en: Delta debugging, from Andreas Zeller and Ralf Hildebrandt in 2002, shrinks a failing input while the failure persists. <bookmark mark='a'/> Ours tries removing each statement or block, from the bottom up, and keeps a removal if the program still shows the disagreement. <bookmark mark='b'/> Seventy-five tests, fifty-four accepted removals, under five seconds. <bookmark mark='c'/> Nine lines are left. <bookmark mark='d'/> f1 of minus seven returns minus seven. The second byte printed is minus seven over two hundred and fifty-six: zero for Pebble, minus one for the broken folder, so the byte is F F instead of zero zero. The bug, in one line.
b918919a92b8.zh: 增量调试由 Andreas Zeller 和 Ralf Hildebrandt 在2002年提出，它在失败持续存在的前提下缩小一个失败的输入。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们的版本从下往上，尝试删除每一条语句或每一个块，只要程序仍然表现出不一致，就保留这次删除。<bookmark mark='b'/>75次测试，接受了54次删除，用时不到5秒。<bookmark mark='c'/>剩下9行。<bookmark mark='d'/>f1 作用于负7，返回负7。打印的第二个字节是负7除以256：对 Pebble 是0，对坏掉的折叠器是负1，所以这个字节是 FF 而不是 00。这个错误，归结到了一行里。

78935441ee6f.en: The real test is the Job, Part 13's word-counting program. <bookmark mark='a'/> We compile it at every level and run it on five texts, up to two hundred and twenty-six bytes. <bookmark mark='b'/> Every level prints exactly what the interpreter prints, and the interpreter agrees with an independent Python version. <bookmark mark='c'/> The optimizations pay: on the longest text, level three takes twelve thousand eight hundred and fifty-four steps, against thirty-eight thousand six hundred and thirty-three unoptimized. <bookmark mark='d'/> But five agreeing inputs are evidence, not proof.
78935441ee6f.zh: 真正的考验是那项任务，第13部分的数词程序。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们在每个级别上编译它，在五段文本上运行，最长的有226个字节。<bookmark mark='b'/>每个级别打印的都和解释器完全一样，而解释器又与一个独立的 Python 版本一致。<bookmark mark='c'/>优化是值得的：在最长的文本上，第三级用了12854步，而未优化的是38633步。<bookmark mark='d'/>但五个一致的输入只是证据，而不是证明。

ba8f76bc2280.en: Translation validation, from Amir Pnueli, Michael Siegel and Eli Singerman in 1998, checks every compilation instead of sampling inputs. <bookmark mark='a'/> Proving a compiler correct for every program is CompCert's hard road. <bookmark mark='b'/> Instead, after each run, a validator checks that this output means the same as this input; only the validator must be trusted. <bookmark mark='c'/> For our bug, a validator for constant folding would recompute each folded constant by Pebble's rules: minus seven over two hundred and fifty-six is zero, not minus one, so the compilation is refused. <bookmark mark='d'/> Equivalence is undecidable in general, so validators target particular passes and may answer don't know. CompCert's register allocation is checked this way, by a validator proved in Coq.
ba8f76bc2280.zh: 翻译确认由 Amir Pnueli、Michael Siegel 和 Eli Singerman 在1998年提出，它检查每一次编译，而不是对输入抽样。<bookmark mark='a'/>证明一个编译器对每一个程序都正确，是 CompCert 走的那条难路。<bookmark mark='b'/>换个做法，每次运行之后，由一个确认器检查这份输出和这份输入含义相同；需要信任的只有确认器。<bookmark mark='c'/>对我们的错误，一个针对常量折叠的确认器会按 Pebble 的规则重新计算每一个折叠出来的常量：负7除以256是0，不是负1，所以这次编译被拒绝。<bookmark mark='d'/>等价性一般来说是不可判定的，所以确认器只针对特定的遍，并且可能回答“不知道”。CompCert 的寄存器分配就是这样检查的，用的是一个在 Coq 中证明过的确认器。

da491360cdf6.en: Now let the code carry its own proof. <bookmark mark='a'/> In George Necula's proof-carrying code, from 1997, an untrusted producer ships machine code with a proof that it obeys a safety policy. <bookmark mark='b'/> The consumer computes the verification condition from the code, by weakest preconditions as in chapter four, <bookmark mark='c'/> and checks the proof with a small checker, as in chapter ten; then the code runs with no run-time checks. <bookmark mark='d'/> Tamper with the code and its condition changes, so the proof no longer fits. <bookmark mark='e'/> Descendants include typed assembly language, WebAssembly's validator from Part 15, and Part 31's eBPF verifier, which checks the code itself instead of a shipped proof.
da491360cdf6.zh: 现在让代码自己携带证明。<bookmark mark='a'/>在 George Necula 1997年提出的携带证明的代码中，一个不受信任的生产者交付机器码，并附带一个证明，说明它遵守某个安全策略。<bookmark mark='b'/>消费者从代码计算出验证条件，用的是第四章那样的最弱前置条件，<bookmark mark='c'/>再用一个小检查器检查证明，就像第十章那样；然后代码就可以在没有任何运行时检查的情况下运行。<bookmark mark='d'/>篡改代码，它的条件就会改变，于是证明不再吻合。<bookmark mark='e'/>它的后代包括类型化汇编语言、第15部分的 WebAssembly 验证器，以及第31部分的 eBPF 验证器，后者检查的是代码本身，而不是随附的证明。

e1fabffad323.en: Chapter fifteen, the frontier. Can proof become as routine as testing?
e1fabffad323.zh: 第十五章，前沿：证明能变得像测试一样例行吗？

3eceb5c05f7c.en: Proof is already routine in some places. <bookmark mark='a'/> Amazon's engineers described in 2015 how model-checking TLA-plus specifications of their storage and messaging services found subtle bugs before any code was written. <bookmark mark='b'/> Formally verified cryptographic code, from projects such as HACL-star and Fiat-Crypto, now runs inside major browsers and libraries. <bookmark mark='c'/> And static analysers run on every change at large companies, reporting bugs found by sound approximation. <bookmark mark='d'/> The pattern is to prove the small, critical, stable parts, and test the rest.
3eceb5c05f7c.zh: 在有些地方，证明已经是例行公事。<bookmark mark='a'/>Amazon 的工程师在2015年讲述了，对他们的存储和消息服务的 TLA+ 规约做模型检验，如何在写下任何代码之前就发现了微妙的错误。<bookmark mark='b'/>经过形式化验证的密码学代码，出自 HACL* 和 Fiat-Crypto 这样的项目，如今运行在主流的浏览器和库里。<bookmark mark='c'/>而在大公司里，静态分析器在每一次变更上运行，报告通过可靠近似发现的错误。<bookmark mark='d'/>模式是：证明那些小的、关键的、稳定的部分，其余的靠测试。

eff67fda8ccf.en: The newest change is who writes the proofs. <bookmark mark='a'/> In our LCF kernel from chapter ten, only 69 lines have to be trusted; everything else, including whatever produced the proof, can be wrong without harm, because every step passes through the kernel. <bookmark mark='b'/> That is why language models can be put to work: they now write proofs in Lean, Coq and Dafny, and suggest loop invariants, and in 2024 systems that combined them with search solved olympiad problems with proofs that a kernel checked. <bookmark mark='c'/> The question is no longer whether a machine's proof can be trusted, but how much of a real program's specification it can find and prove on its own.
eff67fda8ccf.zh: 最新的变化在于由谁来写证明。<bookmark mark='a'/>在第十章我们的 LCF 内核里，只有69行需要信任；其他一切，包括产生证明的任何东西，都可以出错而无害，因为每一步都要经过内核。<bookmark mark='b'/>这就是为什么可以让语言模型来干活：它们如今用 Lean、Coq 和 Dafny 写证明，还会提出循环不变量；2024年，把它们与搜索结合起来的系统解出了奥林匹克竞赛题，给出的证明由内核检查过。<bookmark mark='c'/>问题不再是机器的证明能否被信任，而是一个真实程序的规约，它能自己找到并证明多少。

1dd302965465.en: Open problems. <bookmark mark='a'/> Finding the inductive invariants that proofs need, automatically. <bookmark mark='b'/> Knowing where specifications come from, and whether they say what was meant. <bookmark mark='c'/> Proofs that survive the constant change of a million-line system. <bookmark mark='d'/> And verified software on relaxed memory and speculative processors. <bookmark mark='e'/> This part's research problem is the first: an invariant-inference procedure for loops with multiplication, the case where our SAT checking slowed down most, that is complete for a stated class of invariants and fast enough to use.
1dd302965465.zh: 开放问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>自动找到证明所需要的归纳不变量。<bookmark mark='b'/>弄清规约从哪里来，以及它们是否说出了本意。<bookmark mark='c'/>能在一个百万行系统的持续变化中存活下来的证明。<bookmark mark='d'/>以及运行在松弛内存和推测执行处理器上的、经过验证的软件。<bookmark mark='e'/>这一部分的研究题是第一个：为带乘法的循环设计一个不变量推断过程，这正是我们的 SAT 检查慢得最厉害的情形；它要对一类明确给出的不变量是完备的，并且快到足以实用。

7ca716b4bd7c.en: What we built in this part. Floyd–Hoare logic and its rules, with invariants for loops and variants for termination. Weakest preconditions, turned into formulas and checked by our own SAT solver, which found the binary search overflow and proved the fix. Separation logic, so that proofs about the heap can be local. Model checking: explicit, symbolic with BDDs, and bounded with SAT, on Peterson's lock, the philosophers, two-phase commit and Raft. Abstract interpretation with widening; an LCF kernel; and a fuzzer that caught a planted bug in our own compiler. One idea runs through it: correctness cannot be decided in general, but it can be proved in particular.
7ca716b4bd7c.zh: 这一部分我们搭建了什么。弗洛伊德–霍尔逻辑及其规则，用不变量处理循环，用递减量处理终止。最弱前置条件，把它们变成公式，用我们自己的 SAT 求解器检查，它找到了二分查找的溢出，并证明了修正。分离逻辑，让关于堆的证明可以是局部的。模型检验：显式的、用 BDD 的符号检验，以及用 SAT 的有界检验，用在彼得森锁、哲学家就餐、两阶段提交和 Raft 上。带加宽的抽象解释；一个 LCF 内核；还有一个在我们自己的编译器里抓到了植入错误的模糊测试器。一个想法贯穿始终：正确性一般来说无法判定，但在具体情形中可以证明。

a2e1a60dcf4a.en: Where this comes back. Part 55 asks whether a compiler can be trusted at all. Part 58 gives programs the mathematical meaning these proofs rest on. Part 59 proves the limits of distributed protocols. Part 60 checks hardware against its specification. And Part 61 treats proof as a research method.
a2e1a60dcf4a.zh: 这些内容会在哪里再出现。第55部分问一个编译器到底能不能被信任。第58部分给出这些证明所依赖的、程序的数学意义。第59部分证明分布式协议的极限。第60部分对照规约检查硬件。第61部分则把证明当作一种研究方法。

533417e369b1.en: In practice. Write invariants as assertions, so they document and test at the same time. State properties rather than examples, and let the tool shrink the failures. Fuzz in continuous integration, with sanitizers, and keep the corpus. Model every tricky protocol before writing it. And prove the small critical core: parsers, cryptography, kernels.
533417e369b1.zh: 实践中。把不变量写成断言，这样它们既是文档，又是测试。陈述性质而不是例子，让工具去收缩失败用例。在持续集成里做模糊测试，配上消毒器，并保留语料库。在编写每一个棘手的协议之前，先为它建模。还有，证明那个小而关键的核心：解析器、密码学、内核。

2b4130cc9983.en: Six problems, with full solutions in the part's notes. Pause on any of them. The fifth is a build problem: plant a bug of your own in the optimizer and count how many random programs it takes the fuzzer to find it. The last, marked with a star, is a research problem: complete and practical invariant inference for loops with multiplication.
2b4130cc9983.zh: 六道习题，完整解答在这一部分的笔记里。可以在任何一道上暂停。第五道是构建题：在优化器里植入一个你自己的错误，数一数模糊测试器要用多少个随机程序才能找到它。最后一道标有星号，是研究题：为带乘法的循环做完备而实用的不变量推断。

0ea6a38e5bc3.en: Next time, Part 55, the finale of the degree: trusting trust. Security is a property of the whole tower, and every layer leaks. We build Ken Thompson's backdoored compiler against our own, catch it, and walk the tower one last time, from a NAND gate to a cluster.
0ea6a38e5bc3.zh: 下一次，第55部分，这个学位课程的终章：对信任的信任。安全性是整座塔的性质，而每一层都会泄漏。我们会对照我们自己的编译器，搭建肯·汤普森那个带后门的编译器，抓住它，再最后一次走遍整座塔，从一个与非门到一个集群。

9bd24692775d.en: The books and papers this part follows are on screen and in the notes. Thank you for watching.
9bd24692775d.zh: 这一部分所依据的书和论文都在屏幕上和笔记里。感谢观看。
